bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑第050卷

translations.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 50.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 50.

sentences.zh: 【漢紀四十二】起柔兆執徐，盡閼逢困敦，凡九年。

translations.literal: 【Han Records 42】 From Rouzhao Zhixu through Efeng Kundun—in all, nine years.
translations.idiomatic: 【Han Records 42】 From the first year of the Rouzhao cycle through the last year of the Efeng cycle—nine years in all.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，蒼梧、鬱林、合浦蠻夷反；

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, the barbarian Yi of Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu rebelled;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, the tribal Yi of Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu rebelled;

sentences.zh: 二月，遣侍御史任逴督州郡兵討之。

translations.literal: in the second month, Palace Attendant Ren Chao was sent to supervise commandery and provincial troops in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: in the second month Palace Attendant Ren Chao was sent to supervise the commandery and provincial troops in suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 郡國十地震。

translations.literal: Ten commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 三月，辛亥，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinhai, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，京師旱。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the capital had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, the capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 五月，武陵蠻反，州郡討破之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Wuling barbarians rebelled; the province and commanderies attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Wuling tribes rebelled; the province and commanderies attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，度遼將軍鄧遵率南單于擊零昌於靈州，斬首八百餘級。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, General Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun led the Southern Chanyu to strike Lingchang at Lingzhou and beheaded more than eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day General Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun led the Southern Chanyu against Lingchang at Lingzhou and took more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 越巂徼外夷舉種內屬。

translations.literal: The Yi beyond the frontier of Yuexi led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes beyond the Yuexi frontier led their clans to submit.

sentences.zh: 六月，中郎將任尚遣兵擊破先零羌於丁奚城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Colonel of the Gentlemen Ren Shang sent troops and defeated the Xianling Qiang at Dingxi city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Colonel Ren Shang sent troops and defeated the Xianling Qiang at Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，武陵蠻復反，州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Wuling barbarians rebelled again; the province and commanderies attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the Wuling tribes rebelled again; the province and commanderies attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 九月，築馮翊北界候塢五百所以備羌。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, five hundred border beacon towers were built on the northern frontier of Fengyi to guard against the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month five hundred border beacon towers were built on the northern frontier of Fengyi to guard against the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，蒼梧、鬱林、合浦蠻夷降。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, the barbarian Yi of Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, the tribal Yi of Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 舊制：公卿、二千石、刺史不得行三年喪，司徒劉愷以為「非所以師表百姓，宣美風俗。

translations.literal: By old regulation, ducal ministers, two-thousand-dan officials, and provincial inspectors might not observe the three-year mourning. Minister of Education Liu Kai held that "this is not the means to be a teacher and model for the common people and to spread fine customs."
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation ducal ministers, two-thousand-dan officials, and provincial inspectors might not observe three-year mourning. Minister of Education Liu Kai held that "this is not how to teach and model the people or spread fine customs."

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，初聽大臣行三年喪。

translations.literal: " On the day bingxu, for the first time great ministers were permitted to observe the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu day great ministers were for the first time permitted to observe three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，郡國九地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, nine commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day nine commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁巳，任尚遣兵擊零昌於北地，殺其妻子，燒其廬落，斬首七百餘級。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, Ren Shang sent troops to strike Lingchang in Beidi, killed his wife and children, burned his lodges and settlements, and beheaded more than seven hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi day, Ren Shang sent troops against Lingchang in Beidi, killed his wife and children, burned his lodges and settlements, and took more than seven hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on the new moon of the day yisi, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on the new moon of yisi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，武庫災。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Arsenal burned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Arsenal burned.

sentences.zh: 任尚遣當闐種羌榆鬼等刺殺杜季貢，封榆鬼為破羌侯。

translations.literal: Ren Shang sent the Dangtian tribal Qiang Yugui and the rest to assassinate Du Jigong and enfeoffed Yugui as Marquis Who Breaks the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang sent the Dangtian Qiang Yugui and others to assassinate Du Jigong and enfeoffed Yugui as Marquis Who Breaks the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 司空袁敞，廉勁不阿權貴，失鄧氏旨。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Yuan Chang was upright and firm and would not fawn on the powerful; he lost favor with the Deng clan.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Yuan Chang was upright and firm and would not fawn on the powerful; he lost favor with the Deng clan.

sentences.zh: 尚書郎張俊有私書與敞子俊，怨家封上之。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Masters of Writing Zhang Jun had a private letter to Chang's son Jun. An enemy household sealed and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Masters of Writing Zhang Jun had sent a private letter to Chang's son Jun. An enemy household sealed it and submitted it to court.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，戊申，敞坐策免，自殺；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wushen, Chang was dismissed by written impeachment and killed himself;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on wushen day, Chang was impeached and dismissed, then killed himself;

sentences.zh: 俊等下獄當死。

translations.literal: Jun and the rest were imprisoned and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and the rest were imprisoned and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 俊上書自訟；

translations.literal: Jun submitted a memorial pleading his own case;
translations.idiomatic: Jun memorialized in his own defense;

sentences.zh: 臨刑，太后詔以減死論。

translations.literal: as execution approached, the empress dowager issued an edict sentencing them to reduced death.
translations.idiomatic: as execution approached the empress dowager issued an edict commuting the sentence to reduced death.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遼西鮮卑連休等入寇，郡兵與烏桓大人於秩居等共擊，大破之，斬首千三百級。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Liaoxi Xianbei Lianxiu and the rest invaded. Commandery troops, together with the Wuhuan grandees Yuzhiju and the rest, jointly attacked and greatly defeated them, beheading more than thirteen hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Liaoxi Xianbei Lianxiu and others invaded. Commandery troops, together with the Wuhuan grandees Yuzhiju and others, attacked jointly and routed them, taking more than thirteen hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 六月，戊辰，三郡雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuchen, three commanderies had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, three commanderies were struck by hail.

sentences.zh: 尹就坐不能定益州，征抵罪；

translations.literal: Yin Jiu was charged with being unable to pacify Yizhou, was summoned, and punished;
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jiu was charged with failing to pacify Yizhou, was summoned to court, and punished;

sentences.zh: 以益州刺史張喬領其軍屯，招誘叛羌，稍稍降散。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yizhou Zhang Qiao was made to lead his army in garrison, entice the rebel Qiang, and gradually they surrendered and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Zhang Qiao of Yizhou took over his army in garrison, enticed the rebel Qiang, and gradually they surrendered and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，京師及郡國十雨水。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the capital and ten commanderies and kingdoms had rain disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the capital and ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月，護羌校尉任尚復募效功種羌號封刺殺零昌；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Protector of the Qiang Ren Shang again recruited the Xiaogong tribal Qiang Haofeng to assassinate Lingchang;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Protector of the Qiang Ren Shang again recruited the Xiaogong Qiang Haofeng to assassinate Lingchang;

sentences.zh: 封號封為羌王。

translations.literal: Haofeng was enfeoffed as King of the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Haofeng was enfeoffed as King of the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，己卯，彭城靖王恭薨。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jimao, Prince Jing of Pengcheng Gong died.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on jimao day, Prince Jing of Pengcheng Gong died.

sentences.zh: 越巂夷以郡縣賦斂煩數，十二月，大牛種封離等反，殺遂久令。

translations.literal: The Yi of Yuexi, because commandery and county levies were frequent and burdensome—in the twelfth month the Daniu tribal Fengli and the rest rebelled and killed the magistrate of Suijiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi of Yuexi, finding commandery and county levies frequent and burdensome—in the twelfth month the Daniu tribal leader Fengli and others rebelled and killed the magistrate of Suijiu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，任尚與騎都尉馬賢共擊先零羌狼莫，追至北地，相持六十餘日，戰於富平河上，大破之，斬首五千級，狼莫逃去。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Ren Shang and Colonel of Cavalry Ma Xian jointly attacked the Xianling Qiang Langmo, pursued to Beidi, faced each other for more than sixty days, fought on the Fu River in Ping, and greatly defeated them, beheading five thousand heads. Langmo fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Ren Shang and Colonel of Cavalry Ma Xian jointly attacked the Xianling Qiang Langmo, pursued him to Beidi, and fought for more than sixty days on the Fu River at Ping. They routed him and took five thousand heads. Langmo fled.

sentences.zh: 於是西河虔人種羌萬人詣鄧遵降，隴右平。

translations.literal: Thereupon ten thousand Qianren tribal Qiang of Xihe came to Deng Zun to surrender, and Longyou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon ten thousand Qianren Qiang of Xihe came to Deng Zun to surrender, and Longyou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國十三地震。

translations.literal: This year, thirteen commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: This year thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 春，三月，京師及郡國五旱。

translations.literal: In spring, the third month, the capital and five commanderies and kingdoms had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the third month, the capital and five commanderies and kingdoms suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 夏，六月，高句驪與濊貊寇玄菟。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Koguryŏ and the Yemaek raided Xuantu.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the sixth month, Koguryŏ and the Yemaek raided Xuantu.

sentences.zh: 永昌、益州、蜀郡夷皆叛應封離，眾至十餘萬，破壞二十餘縣，殺長吏，焚掠百姓，骸骨委積，千里無人。

translations.literal: The Yi of Yongchang, Yizhou, and Shu Commandery all rebelled in response to Fengli. Their masses reached more than a hundred thousand. They destroyed more than twenty counties, killed chief officials, burned and plundered the people, and bones lay heaped in piles—for a thousand li there was no one.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi of Yongchang, Yizhou, and Shu Commandery all rebelled in support of Fengli. Their forces rose above a hundred thousand. They destroyed more than twenty counties, killed chief officials, burned and plundered the people, and bones lay heaped in piles—for a thousand li there was no one left.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the new moon of the day bingshen, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the new moon of bingshen day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 代郡鮮卑入寇，殺長史；

translations.literal: The Xianbei of Dai Commandery invaded and killed the chief clerk;
translations.idiomatic: The Dai Xianbei invaded and killed the chief clerk;

sentences.zh: 發緣邊甲卒、黎陽營兵屯上谷以備之。

translations.literal: border garrison soldiers and troops of the Liyang camp were dispatched to garrison Shanggu to guard against them.
translations.idiomatic: border garrison soldiers and troops of the Liyang camp were stationed in Shanggu to guard against them.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，鮮卑寇上谷，攻居庸關，復發緣邊諸郡黎陽營兵、積射士步騎二萬人屯列衝要。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Xianbei raided Shanggu and attacked Juyong Pass. Again border commanderies' Liyang camp troops and crossbow soldiers—twenty thousand infantry and cavalry—were dispatched to garrison strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, the Xianbei raided Shanggu and attacked Juyong Pass. Again twenty thousand infantry and cavalry from the border commanderies' Liyang camp and crossbow corps were stationed at strategic points.

sentences.zh: 鄧遵募上郡全無種羌雕何刺殺狼莫；

translations.literal: Deng Zun recruited the Shangjun Quanwu tribal Qiang Diaohe to assassinate Langmo;
translations.idiomatic: Deng Zun recruited the Shangjun Quanwu Qiang Diaohe to assassinate Langmo;

sentences.zh: 封雕何為羌侯。

translations.literal: Diaohe was enfeoffed as Marquis of the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Diaohe was enfeoffed as Marquis of the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 自羌叛十餘年間，軍旅之費，凡用二百四十餘億，府帑空竭，邊民及內郡死者不可勝數，並、涼二州遂至虛耗。

translations.literal: From the Qiang rebellion over more than ten years, military expenses in all used more than twenty-four billion. The treasury was emptied, border people and inner commanderies died beyond counting, and Bing and Liang provinces were brought to utter exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: In the more than ten years since the Qiang rebellion, military expenses totaled more than twenty-four billion. The treasury was emptied, border people and inner commanderies died beyond counting, and Bing and Liang provinces were brought to utter exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 及零昌、狼莫死，諸羌瓦解，三輔、益州無復寇警。

translations.literal: When Lingchang and Langmo died, the various Qiang collapsed, and the Three Adjuncts and Yizhou had no further alarms of raiding.
translations.idiomatic: When Lingchang and Langmo died the Qiang collapsed, and the Three Adjuncts and Yizhou had no further raids to fear.

sentences.zh: 詔封鄧遵為武陽侯，邑三千戶。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Deng Zun as Marquis of Wuyang with a fief of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Deng Zun as Marquis of Wuyang with a fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 遵以太后從弟，故爵封優大。

translations.literal: Because Zun was the empress dowager's cousin, his rank and enfeoffment were especially large.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zun was the empress dowager's cousin, his rank and fief were especially generous.

sentences.zh: 任尚與遵爭功，又坐詐增首級、受賕枉法贓千萬已上，十二月，檻車征尚，棄市，沒入財物。

translations.literal: Ren Shang disputed merit with Zun and was also charged with falsely inflating head counts and taking bribes and perverting the law for goods worth more than ten million. In the twelfth month he was summoned in a prisoner cart, executed in the marketplace, and his property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang disputed merit with Zun and was also charged with falsely inflating head counts and taking bribes worth more than ten million while perverting the law. In the twelfth month he was summoned in a prisoner cart, executed in the marketplace, and his property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 鄧騭子侍中鳳嘗受尚馬，騭髡妻及鳳以謝罪。

translations.literal: Deng Ni's son Palace Attendant Feng had once received a horse from Shang. Ni shaved his wife and Feng to apologize for the crime.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Ni's son Palace Attendant Feng had once accepted a horse from Shang. Ni shaved his wife and Feng as an apology for the offense.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國十四地震。

translations.literal: This year, fourteen commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: This year fourteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 太后弟悝、閶皆卒，封悝子廣宗為葉侯，閶子忠為西華侯。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's younger brothers Kui and Chang both died. Kui's son Guangzong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ye; Chang's son Zhong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xihua.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's younger brothers Kui and Chang both died. Kui's son Guangzong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ye; Chang's son Zhong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xihua.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，乙巳，京師及郡國四十二地震。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on the day yisi, the capital and forty-two commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on yisi day, the capital and forty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，沛國、勃海大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Pei and Bohai had great wind and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Pei and Bohai suffered great wind and hail.

sentences.zh: 五月，京師旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the capital had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 六月，丙戌，平原哀王得薨，無子。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingxu, Prince Ai of Pingyuan De died without sons.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, Prince Ai of Pingyuan De died without heirs.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，鮮卑寇馬城塞，殺長吏，度遼將軍鄧遵及中郎將馬續率南單于追擊，大破之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Xianbei raided Macheng Pass and killed the chief clerk. General Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun and Colonel of the Gentlemen Ma Xu led the Southern Chanyu in pursuit and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the Xianbei raided Macheng Pass and killed the chief clerk. General Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun and Colonel Ma Xu led the Southern Chanyu in pursuit and routed them.

sentences.zh: 九月，癸巳，陳懷王竦薨，無子，國除。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guisi, Prince Huai of Chen Song died without sons; the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi day, Prince Huai of Chen Song died without heirs and the state was abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬，十二月，戊午朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on the new moon of the day wuwu, the sun was eclipsed to totality.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the new moon of wuwu day, there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 郡國八地震。

translations.literal: Eight commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Eight commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，太后征和帝弟濟北王壽、河間王開子男女年五歲以上四十餘人，及鄧氏近親子孫三十餘人，並為開邸第，教學經書，躬自監試。

translations.literal: This year the empress dowager summoned more than forty sons and daughters of Emperor He's younger brother Prince Shou of Jibei and of the sons of Prince Kai of Hejian, five years of age and above, and more than thirty close Deng kin and descendants, opened residences for them all, taught them the classics, and personally supervised their examinations.
translations.idiomatic: This year the empress dowager summoned more than forty sons and daughters of Emperor He's younger brother Prince Shou of Jibei and of Prince Kai of Hejian's sons, five years of age and above, and more than thirty close Deng kin and descendants. She opened residences for them all, taught them the classics, and personally supervised their examinations.

sentences.zh: 詔從兄河南尹豹、越騎校尉康等曰：「末世貴戚食祿之家，溫衣美飯，乘堅驅良，而面牆術學，不識臧否，斯故禍敗所從來也。

translations.literal: An edict to her cousin Intendant of Henan Bao, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Kang, and the rest, said, "In a degenerate age, noble kin and salary-eating households have warm clothes and fine food, ride strong carriages and drive fine horses, yet face the wall in arts and learning, not knowing good from ill—this is where disaster and ruin come from."
translations.idiomatic: An edict to her cousin Intendant of Henan Bao, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Kang, and the rest said, "In a degenerate age noble kin and salary-eating households have warm clothes and fine food, ride strong carriages and drive fine horses, yet face the wall in learning and cannot tell good from ill—this is where disaster and ruin come from."

sentences.zh: 豫章有芝草生，太守劉祗欲上之，以問郡人唐檀，檀曰：「方今外戚豪盛，君道微弱，斯豈嘉瑞乎！

translations.literal: In Yuzhang, auspicious fungus-grass grew. The Administrator Liu Zhi wished to present it upward and asked the commandery man Tang Tan. Tan said, "At present empresses' kin are grand and flourishing while the ruler's way is weak—how can this be an auspicious portent!"
translations.idiomatic: In Yuzhang auspicious fungus-grass appeared. Administrator Liu Zhi wished to present it to court and asked the commandery man Tang Tan. Tan said, "At present empresses' kin are grand and flourishing while the ruler's way is weak—how can this be an auspicious portent!"

sentences.zh: 」祗乃止。

translations.literal: " Zhi thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhi thereupon desisted.

sentences.zh: 益州刺史張喬遣從事楊竦將兵至楪榆，擊封離等，大破之，斬首三萬餘級，獲生口千五百人。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yizhou Zhang Qiao sent Assistant Yang Song to lead troops to Yeyu, attack Fengli and the rest, and greatly defeat them, beheading more than thirty thousand heads and capturing fifteen hundred living.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Zhang Qiao of Yizhou sent Assistant Yang Song to lead troops to Yeyu, attack Fengli and his allies, and rout them, taking more than thirty thousand heads and fifteen hundred captives.

sentences.zh: 封離等惶怖，斬其同謀渠帥，詣竦乞降。

translations.literal: Fengli and the rest were fearful and terrified, beheaded their fellow conspirator chieftains, and came to Song to beg surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Fengli and his allies, in fear, beheaded their fellow conspirator chieftains and came to Song to beg surrender.

sentences.zh: 竦厚加慰納，其餘三十六種皆來降附。

translations.literal: Song generously added comfort and acceptance; the remaining thirty-six tribes all came to surrender and attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Song received them generously with comfort and acceptance; the remaining thirty-six tribes all came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 竦因奏長吏奸猾，侵犯蠻夷者九十人，皆減死論。

translations.literal: Song thereupon memorialized that ninety chief officials who were crafty and had encroached on the barbarian Yi all received reduced-death sentences.
translations.idiomatic: Song then memorialized that ninety chief officials who were crafty and had encroached on the tribal Yi all received commuted sentences of reduced death.

sentences.zh: 初，西域諸國既絕於漢，北匈奴復以兵威役屬之，與共為邊寇。

translations.literal: Earlier, the states of the Western Regions having been cut off from Han, the Northern Xiongnu again by military might made them subject and together they became border raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, once the Western Region states had been cut off from Han, the Northern Xiongnu again brought them under control by force and together they raided the border.

sentences.zh: 敦煌太守曹宗患之，乃上遣行長史索班將千餘人屯伊吾以招撫之。

translations.literal: Administrator of Dunhuang Cao Zong was troubled by this and thereupon memorialized upward, sending Acting Chief Clerk Suo Ban to lead more than a thousand men to garrison Yiwu to entice and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator Cao Zong of Dunhuang was troubled by this and memorialized to send Acting Chief Clerk Suo Ban with more than a thousand men to garrison Yiwu and entice them back.

sentences.zh: 於是車師前王及鄯善王復來降。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Former King of Cheshi and the King of Shanshan again came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Former King of Cheshi and the King of Shanshan again came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 初，疏勒王安國死，無子，國人立其舅子遺腹為王，遺腹叔父臣磐在月氏，月氏納而立之。

translations.literal: Earlier, King Anguo of Shule died without sons. The people of the state installed his sister's son, a posthumous child, as king. The posthumous child's uncle Chenpan was in the Yuezhi; the Yuezhi received him and installed him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier King Anguo of Shule died without sons. The people installed his sister's posthumous son as king. The child's uncle Chenpan was among the Yuezhi; the Yuezhi received him and installed him as king.

sentences.zh: 後莎車畔於窴，屬疏勒，疏勒遂強，與龜茲、於窴為敵國焉。

translations.literal: Later Shache rebelled against Yutian, submitted to Shule, and Shule thereupon grew strong, becoming a rival state with Kucha and Yutian.
translations.idiomatic: Later Shache rebelled against Yutian and submitted to Shule. Shule then grew strong and became a rival of Kucha and Yutian.

sentences.zh: 春，三月，丁酉，濟北惠王壽薨。

translations.literal: In spring, the third month, on the day dingyou, Prince Hui of Jibei Shou died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the third month, on dingyou day, Prince Hui of Jibei Shou died.

sentences.zh: 北匈奴率車師後王軍就共殺後部司馬及敦煌長史索班等，遂擊走其前王，略有北道。

translations.literal: The Northern Xiongnu, leading the Later King of Cheshi Junjiu, jointly killed the Rear-Department Colonel and Dunhuang Chief Clerk Suo Ban and the rest, then attacked and drove off the Former King and seized much of the Northern Route.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Xiongnu, with the Later King of Cheshi Junjiu, jointly killed the Rear-Department Colonel and Dunhuang Chief Clerk Suo Ban and others, then attacked and drove off the Former King and seized much of the Northern Route.

sentences.zh: 鄯善逼急，求救於曹宗，宗因此請出兵五千人擊匈奴，以報索班之恥，因復取西域；

translations.literal: Shanshan was pressed hard and sought rescue from Cao Zong. Zong thereupon requested to send out five thousand troops to strike the Xiongnu, avenge Suo Ban's disgrace, and thereby recover the Western Regions;
translations.idiomatic: Shanshan was hard pressed and sought rescue from Cao Zong. Zong thereupon requested five thousand troops to strike the Xiongnu, avenge Suo Ban's death, and recover the Western Regions;

sentences.zh: 公卿多以為宜閉玉門關，絕西域。

translations.literal: most among the ducal ministers held that one ought to close the Jade Gate Pass and cut off the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: most among the ducal ministers held that the Jade Gate Pass should be closed and the Western Regions cut off.

sentences.zh: 太后聞軍司馬班勇有父風，召詣朝堂問之。

translations.literal: The empress dowager heard that Army Major Ban Yong had his father's manner and summoned him to the court hall to question him.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager heard that Army Major Ban Yong had his father's manner and summoned him to court to question him.

sentences.zh: 為上議曰：「昔孝武皇帝患匈奴強盛，於是開通西域，論者以為奪匈奴府藏，斷其右臂。

translations.literal: He addressed the sovereign's deliberation, saying, "In the past Emperor Xiaowu of Han was troubled by the Xiongnu's strength and flourishing and thereupon opened and connected the Western Regions. Deliberators held that this seized the Xiongnu's treasury stores and severed their right arm."
translations.idiomatic: He addressed the court, saying, "In the past Emperor Wu of Han was troubled by the Xiongnu's strength and thereupon opened the Western Regions. Deliberators held that this seized the Xiongnu treasury and severed their right arm."

sentences.zh: 光武中興，未遑外事，故匈奴負強，驅率諸國；

translations.literal: "Emperor Guangwu restored the dynasty and had no leisure for foreign affairs, so the Xiongnu relied on their strength and drove and led the various states;
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor Guangwu restored the dynasty and had no leisure for foreign affairs, so the Xiongnu relied on their strength and drove the various states;

sentences.zh: 及至永平，再攻敦煌，河西諸郡，城門晝閉。

translations.literal: "down to Yongping they twice attacked Dunhuang and the commanderies of Hexi, and city gates were closed by day."
translations.idiomatic: "down to the Yongping era they twice attacked Dunhuang and the Hexi commanderies, and city gates were closed even by day."

sentences.zh: 孝明皇帝深惟廟策，乃命虎臣出征西域，故匈奴遠遁，邊境得安；

translations.literal: "Emperor Xiaoming deeply weighed the temple strategies and then ordered tiger ministers to campaign in the Western Regions. Therefore the Xiongnu fled far away and the borderlands obtained peace;
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor Ming deeply weighed the temple strategies and ordered tiger ministers to campaign in the Western Regions. The Xiongnu fled far away and the borderlands were secured;

sentences.zh: 及至永元，莫不內屬。

translations.literal: "down to Yongyuan, none failed to submit inward."
translations.idiomatic: "down to the Yongyuan era, all submitted inward."

sentences.zh: 會間者羌亂，西域復絕，北虜遂遣責諸國，備其逋租，高其價直，嚴以期會，鄯善、車師皆懷憤怨，思樂事漢，其路無從；

translations.literal: "It happened that recently there was Qiang disorder, the Western Regions were again cut off, and the northern enemy thereupon sent to exact from the various states, collected their overdue rents, raised their prices, and was strict about deadlines. Shanshan and Cheshi both harbored anger and resentment, wished and delighted to serve Han, yet had no road thereto;
translations.idiomatic: "Then came the recent Qiang disorders, the Western Regions were cut off again, and the northern enemy sent collectors to the various states, demanded overdue tribute, raised prices, and enforced strict deadlines. Shanshan and Cheshi both nursed anger and wished to serve Han, yet had no way to reach us;

sentences.zh: 前所以時有叛者，皆由牧養失宜，還為其害故也。

translations.literal: "the reason there were rebels from time to time before was all because nurturing and governance were improper and they became harmful in return."
translations.idiomatic: "the reason there were rebels before was that governance was improper and turned harmful in return."

sentences.zh: 今曹宗徒恥於前負，欲報雪匈奴，而不尋出兵故事，未度當時之宜也。

translations.literal: "Now Cao Zong is merely shamed by the earlier defeat and wishes to avenge and wipe away the Xiongnu, yet does not seek out precedents for sending troops and has not measured what is fitting for the present time."
translations.idiomatic: "Now Cao Zong is merely shamed by the earlier defeat and wishes to avenge the Xiongnu, yet does not seek precedents for sending troops and has not weighed what suits the present."

sentences.zh: 夫要功荒外，萬無一成。

translations.literal: "To demand achievement beyond the wild borderlands—ten thousand in ten thousand there is not one success."
translations.idiomatic: "To demand achievement beyond the wild borderlands—success is almost never won."

sentences.zh: 若兵連禍結，悔無所及。

translations.literal: "If war links with calamity and knots together, regret will have nowhere to reach."
translations.idiomatic: "If war links with calamity, regret will come too late."

sentences.zh: 況今府藏未充，師無後繼，是示弱於遠夷，暴短於海內，臣愚以為不可許也。

translations.literal: "Moreover, now the treasury is not full and the army has no follow-on support—this shows weakness to distant barbarians and exposes shortcomings within the seas. Your servant foolishly thinks it cannot be permitted."
translations.idiomatic: "Moreover the treasury is not full and the army has no follow-on support—this shows weakness to distant barbarians and exposes our shortcomings at home. I foolishly think it cannot be permitted."

sentences.zh: 舊敦煌郡有營兵三百人，今宜復之，復置護西域副校尉，居於敦煌，如永元故事，又宜遣西域長史將五百人屯樓蘭，西當焉耆、龜茲徑路，南強鄯善、於窴心膽，北扞匈奴，東近敦煌，如此誠便。

translations.literal: "Formerly Dunhuang Commandery had three hundred garrison soldiers; now they ought to be restored. The Deputy Colonel Protecting the Western Regions ought also to be restored, dwelling at Dunhuang as in the Yongyuan precedent. One ought also to send the Chief Clerk of the Western Regions to lead five hundred men to garrison Loulan—west blocking the direct routes of Yanqi and Kucha, south strengthening the hearts and courage of Shanshan and Yutian, north repelling the Xiongnu, east near Dunhuang. Thus it would truly be convenient."
translations.idiomatic: "Formerly Dunhuang had three hundred garrison soldiers; they should be restored. The Deputy Colonel Protecting the Western Regions should be restored as well, stationed at Dunhuang as in the Yongyuan precedent. The Western Regions Chief Clerk should lead five hundred men to garrison Loulan—blocking west the routes of Yanqi and Kucha, strengthening south the resolve of Shanshan and Yutian, repelling north the Xiongnu, and lying east near Dunhuang. That would truly be the convenient course."

sentences.zh: 尚書復問勇：「利害云何？

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing again questioned Yong: "What are the benefits and harms?"
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing questioned Yong again: "What are the benefits and harms?"

sentences.zh: 」勇對曰：「昔永平之末，始通西域，初遣申郎將居敦煌，後置副校於車師，既為胡虜節度，又禁漢人不得有所侵擾，故外夷歸心，匈奴畏威。

translations.literal: " Yong replied, saying, "In the past, at the end of Yongping, the Western Regions were first connected. At first a gentleman was sent to dwell at Dunhuang; later a deputy colonel was placed at Cheshi. He both regulated the Hu barbarians and forbade Han people from encroaching, so outer barbarians turned their hearts and the Xiongnu feared his authority."
translations.idiomatic: " Yong replied, "At the end of the Yongping era the Western Regions were first opened. At first a gentleman was stationed at Dunhuang; later a deputy colonel was placed at Cheshi. He regulated the Hu tribes and forbade Han encroachment, so the outer tribes turned their hearts and the Xiongnu feared his authority."

sentences.zh: 今鄯善王尤還，漢人外孫。

translations.literal: "Now the King of Shanshan, Youhuan, is a Han person's grandson by a foreign wife."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the King of Shanshan, Youhuan, is the grandson of a Han man by a foreign wife."

sentences.zh: 若匈奴得志，則尤還必死。

translations.literal: "If the Xiongnu gain their will, then Youhuan will surely die."
translations.idiomatic: "If the Xiongnu gain their way, Youhuan will surely die."

sentences.zh: 此等雖同鳥獸，亦知避害，若出屯樓蘭，足以招附其心，愚以為便。

translations.literal: "These, though the same as birds and beasts, also know to avoid harm. If we go out and garrison Loulan, it is enough to entice and attach their hearts. Your servant foolishly thinks it convenient."
translations.idiomatic: "These people, though no better than birds and beasts, also know to avoid harm. If we garrison Loulan it will be enough to win their hearts. I foolishly think it the right course."

sentences.zh: 」長樂衛尉鐔顯、廷尉綦毋參、司隸校尉崔據難曰：「朝廷前所以棄西域者，以其無益於中國，而費難供也。

translations.literal: Changle Commandant Tan Xian, Commandant of Justice Qimu Can, and Director of Retainers Cui Ju objected, saying, "The court formerly abandoned the Western Regions because they were of no benefit to China and the expense was hard to supply.
translations.idiomatic: Changle Commandant Tan Xian, Commandant of Justice Qimu Can, and Director of Retainers Cui Ju objected, saying, "The court formerly abandoned the Western Regions because they benefited China little and the expense was hard to bear."

sentences.zh: 今車師已屬匈奴，鄯善不可保信，一旦反覆，班將能保北虜不為邊害乎？

translations.literal: Now Cheshi has already submitted to the Xiongnu, Shanshan cannot be trusted—if they turn about in a day, can Ban guarantee the northern barbarians will not harm the borders?"
translations.idiomatic: Now Cheshi has already submitted to the Xiongnu and Shanshan cannot be trusted. If they turn about overnight, can Ban guarantee the northern barbarians will not harm the borders?"

sentences.zh: 」勇對曰；

translations.literal: " Yong replied;
translations.idiomatic: " Yong replied:"

sentences.zh: 「今中國置州牧者，以禁郡縣奸猾盜賊也。

translations.literal: "Now China sets up regional inspectors to restrain crafty and slippery bandits in the commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: "Now China sets up regional inspectors to restrain crafty bandits in the commanderies and counties."

sentences.zh: 若州牧能保盜賊不起者，臣亦願以要斬保匈奴之不為邊害也。

translations.literal: If a regional inspector can guarantee bandits do not arise, your servant is also willing to guarantee with his head on the block that the Xiongnu will not harm the borders.
translations.idiomatic: If a regional inspector can guarantee bandits do not arise, your servant is also willing to stake his head that the Xiongnu will not harm the borders."

sentences.zh: 今通西域則虜勢必弱，虜勢弱則為患微矣；

translations.literal: Now if we open the Western Regions the barbarians' power must grow weak; if their power is weak, the harm is slight;
translations.idiomatic: Now if we open the Western Regions the barbarians' power must grow weak; if their power is weak, the harm is slight;"

sentences.zh: 孰與歸其府藏，續其斷臂哉？

translations.literal: how does that compare with returning their treasuries and reattaching their severed arm?"
translations.idiomatic: how does that compare with returning their treasuries and reattaching a severed arm?"

sentences.zh: 今置校尉以扞撫西域，設長史以招懷諸國，若棄而不立，則西域望絕，望絕之後，屈就北虜，緣邊之郡將受困害，恐河西城門必須復有晝閉之儆矣！

translations.literal: Now if we set up a colonel to defend and comfort the Western Regions and establish a chief clerk to win over the various states—if we abandon them and do not establish these, then hope from the Western Regions is cut off; after hope is cut off they will bend to the northern barbarians, and the border commanderies will suffer distress—I fear the gates of Hexi must again have the warning of closing by day!"
translations.idiomatic: Now we set up a colonel to defend and comfort the Western Regions and a chief clerk to win over the various states. If we abandon them and do not establish these, hope from the Western Regions is cut off; afterward they will bend to the northern barbarians and the border commanderies will suffer distress. I fear the gates of Hexi must again be closed by day!"

sentences.zh: 今不廓開朝廷之德而拘屯戍之費，若此，北虜遂熾，豈安邊久長之策哉！

translations.literal: Now if we do not extend the court's virtue but cling to garrison expenses—if it is like this, the northern barbarians will then flourish. Is this a long-term policy for securing the borders!"
translations.idiomatic: Now if we do not extend the court's virtue but cling to garrison expenses, the northern barbarians will flourish. Is that a long-term policy for securing the borders?"

sentences.zh: 」太尉屬毛軫難曰：「今若置校尉，則西域駱驛遣使，求索無厭，與之則費難供，不與則失其心，一旦為匈奴所迫，當復求救，則為役大矣。

translations.literal: " A subordinate of the Grand Commandant, Mao Zhen, objected: "If we now set up a colonel, the Western Regions will send envoys in relays along the post roads, their demands insatiable—if we give to them the expense is hard to supply; if we do not give we lose their hearts. Once they are pressed by the Xiongnu they will again ask for rescue, and the burden of service will be great."
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Commandant subordinate Mao Zhen objected: "If we now set up a colonel, the Western Regions will send envoys along the post roads with insatiable demands. If we give to them the expense is hard to bear; if we refuse we lose their loyalty. Once pressed by the Xiongnu they will again ask for rescue, and the burden will be great."

sentences.zh: 」勇對曰：「今設以西域歸匈奴，而使其恩德大漢，不為鈔盜，則可矣。

translations.literal: " Yong replied: "Suppose we now give the Western Regions to the Xiongnu and make them feel the Han's grace and virtue and not raid and plunder—that would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: " Yong replied: "Suppose we now gave the Western Regions to the Xiongnu and they felt the Han's grace and did not raid—that would suffice."

sentences.zh: 如其不然，則因西域租入之饒，兵馬之眾，以擾動緣邊，是為富仇讎之財，增暴夷之勢也。

translations.literal: If it is not so, then relying on the Western Regions' rich rents and many troops and horses to harass the borderlands is to enrich a foe's wealth and increase violent barbarians' power.
translations.idiomatic: If not, relying on the Western Regions' rich rents and many troops and horses to harass the borderlands enriches a foe and increases violent barbarians' power."

sentences.zh: 置校尉者，宣威布德，以系諸國內向之心，以疑匈奴覬覦之情，而無費財耗國之慮也。

translations.literal: Setting up a colonel displays might and spreads virtue, to bind the various states' hearts turning inward and to make the Xiongnu hesitate in their covetous designs, without worry of wasting wealth and exhausting the state.
translations.idiomatic: Setting up a colonel displays might and spreads virtue, binds the various states' loyalty, and makes the Xiongnu hesitate in their designs, without wasting wealth and exhausting the state."

sentences.zh: 且西域之人，無它求索，其來入者不過稟食而已；

translations.literal: Moreover the people of the Western Regions have no other demands; those who come in need only grain rations;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the people of the Western Regions have no other demands; those who come in need only grain rations;"

sentences.zh: 今若拒絕，勢歸北屬夷虜，並力以寇並、涼，則中國之費不止十億。

translations.literal: if we now reject them, the trend returns north to submit to barbarians, combining strength to raid Bing and Liang—then China's expense will not stop at a billion.
translations.idiomatic: if we now reject them, they will turn north to the barbarians, combine strength to raid Bing and Liang, and China's expense will exceed a billion."

sentences.zh: 置之誠便。

translations.literal: Establishing it is truly expedient."
translations.idiomatic: Establishing it is truly expedient."

sentences.zh: 」於是從勇議，復敦煌郡營兵三百人，置西域副校尉居敦煌，雖復羈縻西域，然亦未能出屯。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they followed Yong's proposal, restored three hundred garrison troops of Dunhuang Commandery, and set up a Vice Colonel of the Western Regions dwelling at Dunhuang; though they again kept the Western Regions on loose reins, they still could not send troops out to encamp.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they followed Yong's proposal, restored Dunhuang's three hundred garrison troops, and set a Vice Colonel of the Western Regions at Dunhuang. Though they again kept the Western Regions on loose reins, they still could not send troops out to encamp.

sentences.zh: 其後匈奴果數與車師共入寇鈔，河西大被其害。

translations.literal: Afterward the Xiongnu indeed several times entered with Cheshi to raid and plunder, and Hexi suffered greatly from them.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the Xiongnu indeed several times entered with Cheshi to raid, and Hexi suffered greatly.

sentences.zh: 沈氐羌寇張掖。

translations.literal: The Shen Di Qiang raided Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: The Shen Di Qiang raided Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丙寅，立皇子保為太子，改元，赦天下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin day, Prince Bao was established as heir apparent, the era name was changed, and all under Heaven was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on bingyin day, Prince Bao was established as heir apparent, the era name was changed, and all under Heaven was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 己巳，紹封陳敬王子崇為陳王，濟北惠王子萇為樂成王，河間孝王子翼為平原王。

translations.literal: On jisi day, continuing enfeoffments, Prince Chong, son of Prince Jing of Chen, was made Prince of Chen; Prince Chang, son of Prince Hui of Jibei, was made Prince of Yuecheng; Prince Yi, son of Prince Xiao of Hejian, was made Prince of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, continuing enfeoffments, Prince Chong, son of Prince Jing of Chen, was made Prince of Chen; Prince Chang, son of Prince Hui of Jibei, was made Prince of Yuecheng; and Prince Yi, son of Prince Xiao of Hejian, was made Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月，護羌校尉馬賢將萬人討沈氐羌於張掖，破之，斬首千八百級，獲生口千餘人，餘虜悉降。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian led ten thousand men to attack the Shen Di Qiang at Zhangye, defeated them, beheaded one thousand eight hundred, captured more than a thousand living captives, and the remaining barbarians all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian led ten thousand men against the Shen Di Qiang at Zhangye, defeated them, took one thousand eight hundred heads and more than a thousand captives, and the remaining barbarians all submitted.

sentences.zh: 時當煎種大豪饑五等，以賢兵在張掖，乃乘虛寇金城，賢還軍追之出塞，斬首數千級而還。

translations.literal: At this time the great chief of the Dangjian tribe Ji Wu and others, because Xian's troops were at Zhangye, took the opportunity to raid Jincheng. Xian returned the army in pursuit beyond the pass, beheaded several thousand, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the great chief of the Dangjian tribe Ji Wu and others, because Xian's troops were at Zhangye, took the opportunity to raid Jincheng. Xian returned in pursuit beyond the pass, took several thousand heads, and returned.

sentences.zh: 燒當、燒何種聞賢軍還，復寇張掖，殺長吏。

translations.literal: The Shaodang and Shaohe tribes, hearing Xian's army had returned, again raided Zhangye and killed the chief official.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaodang and Shaohe tribes, hearing Xian's army had returned, again raided Zhangye and killed the chief official.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the first day yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，己巳，司空李郃免。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jisi day, Minister of Works Li He was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on jisi day, Minister of Works Li He was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以衛尉廬江陳褒為司空。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Commandant of the Guards Chen Bao of Lujiang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Commandant of the Guards Chen Bao of Lujiang was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 京師及郡國三十三大水。

translations.literal: The capital and thirty-three commanderies and kingdoms had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: The capital and thirty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 十二月，永昌徼外撣國王雍曲調遣使者獻樂及幻人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, King Yongqudiao of Shan beyond the border markers of Yongchang sent envoys presenting music and illusionists.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, King Yongqudiao of Shan beyond Yongchang's border markers sent envoys presenting music and illusionists.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，司徒劉愷請致仕；

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Minister over the Masses Liu Kai requested to retire;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Minister over the Masses Liu Kai requested to retire;

sentences.zh: 許之，以千石祿歸養。

translations.literal: it was granted; he was given a thousand-bushel salary to return home and support himself.
translations.idiomatic: it was granted; he was given a thousand-bushel salary to return home.

sentences.zh: 遼西鮮卑大人烏倫、其至鞬各以其眾詣度遼將軍鄧遵降。

translations.literal: The Xianbei great chiefs Wulun of Liaoxi and Qizhijian each with their masses came to Colonel Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei great chiefs Wulun of Liaoxi and Qizhijian each came with their followers to Colonel Who Crosses the Liao Deng Zun to submit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以太常楊震為司徒。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Grand Master of Ceremonies Yang Zhen was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Grand Master of Ceremonies Yang Zhen was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國二十三地震。

translations.literal: This year, twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: This year twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 太后從弟越騎校尉康，以太后久臨朝政，宗門盛滿，數上書太后，以為宜崇公室，自損私權，言甚切至，太后不從。

translations.literal: The empress dowager's cousin by the mother's side, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Kang, because the empress dowager had long held court and governed and the clan gate was full to overflowing, several times submitted memorials to the empress dowager holding that the imperial house ought to be honored and private power reduced—his words were very cutting and direct—the empress dowager did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager's maternal cousin, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Kang, because the empress dowager had long governed and the clan was full to overflowing, several times memorialized her that the imperial house ought to be honored and private power reduced. His words were very direct, but the empress dowager did not heed him.

sentences.zh: 康謝病不朝，太后使內侍者問之；

translations.literal: Kang pleaded illness and did not attend court; the empress dowager sent a palace attendant to inquire;
translations.idiomatic: Kang pleaded illness and did not attend court. The empress dowager sent a palace attendant to inquire;

sentences.zh: 所使者乃康家先婢，自通「中大人」，康聞而詬之。

translations.literal: the one sent was a former maid of Kang's household, who called herself "the great person within"; Kang heard and reviled her.
translations.idiomatic: the envoy was a former maid of Kang's household who called herself "the great person within." Kang heard and reviled her.

sentences.zh: 婢怨恚，還，白康詐疾而言不遜。

translations.literal: The maid bore resentment, returned, and reported that Kang feigned illness and spoke disrespectfully.
translations.idiomatic: The maid bore resentment, returned, and reported that Kang feigned illness and spoke disrespectfully.

sentences.zh: 太后大怒，免康官，遣歸國，絕屬籍。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was greatly angry, dismissed Kang from office, sent him back to his state, and cut him from the clan register.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was greatly angry, dismissed Kang from office, sent him back to his state, and cut him from the clan register.

sentences.zh: 初，當煎種饑五同種大豪盧匆心、忍良等千餘戶別留允街，而首施兩端。

translations.literal: Earlier, Ji Wu of the Dangjian tribe and the great chiefs of the same tribe Lu Congxin, Renliang, and others, more than a thousand households, separately remained at Yunjie, yet played both ends.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ji Wu of the Dangjian tribe and fellow-tribe great chiefs Lu Congxin, Renliang, and others, more than a thousand households, separately remained at Yunjie yet played both ends.

sentences.zh: 春，護羌校尉馬賢召盧匆++心，斬之，因放兵擊其種人，獲首虜二千餘，忍良等皆亡出塞。

translations.literal: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian summoned Lu Cong++xin, beheaded him, and thereupon released troops to attack his tribesmen, obtaining more than two thousand heads and captives; Renliang and others all fled beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian summoned Lu Cong++xin, beheaded him, and released troops to attack his tribesmen, taking more than two thousand heads and captives. Renliang and others all fled beyond the pass.

sentences.zh: 幽州刺史巴郡馮煥、玄菟太守姚光、遼東太守蔡諷等將兵擊高句麗，高句麗王宮遣嗣子遂成詐降，而襲玄菟、遼東，殺傷二千餘人。

translations.literal: Inspector of You Feng Huan of Ba Commandery, Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang, Administrator of Liaodong Cai Feng, and others led troops to attack Goguryeo. King Gong of Goguryeo sent his heir apparent Suicheng to feign submission, then raided Xuantu and Liaodong, killing and wounding more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of You Feng Huan of Ba, Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang, Administrator of Liaodong Cai Feng, and others led troops against Goguryeo. King Gong sent his heir Suicheng to feign submission, then raided Xuantu and Liaodong, killing and wounding more than two thousand.

sentences.zh: 二月，皇太后寢疾，癸亥，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the second month the empress dowager was ill in bed; on guihai day, all under Heaven was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the empress dowager fell ill; on guihai day all under Heaven was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 三月，癸巳，皇太后鄧氏崩。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guisi day, the empress dowager of the Deng clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi day, Empress Dowager Deng died.

sentences.zh: 未及大斂，帝復申前命，封鄧騭為上蔡侯，位特進。

translations.literal: Before the great encoffinment, the emperor again repeated his earlier order and enfeoffed Deng Zhi as Marquis of Shangcai with special advancement rank.
translations.idiomatic: Before the great encoffinment, the emperor again repeated his earlier order and enfeoffed Deng Zhi as Marquis of Shangcai with special advancement rank.

sentences.zh: 丙午，葬和熹皇后。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Empress Hexi was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Empress Hexi was buried.

sentences.zh: 太后自臨朝以來，水旱十載，四夷外侵，盜賊內起，每聞民饑，或達旦不寐，躬自減徹以救災厄，故天下復平，歲還豐穰。

translations.literal: From the time the empress dowager held court, for ten years there were flood and drought, the four barbarians invaded from without, bandits arose within; whenever she heard the people were hungry she sometimes did not sleep until dawn, personally reducing expenditures to rescue disaster and hardship—therefore all under Heaven returned to peace and the years again brought abundance.
translations.idiomatic: From the time the empress dowager held court, for ten years there were flood and drought, barbarians invaded from without, and bandits arose within. Whenever she heard the people were hungry she sometimes did not sleep until dawn and personally reduced expenditures to relieve disaster. Therefore all under Heaven returned to peace and the years again brought abundance.

sentences.zh: 上始親政事，尚書陳忠薦隱逸及直道之士穎川杜根、平原成翊世之徒，上皆納用之。

translations.literal: The emperor began to handle government in person. Master of Writing Chen Zhong recommended recluses and men of the straight path—Du Gen of Yingchuan, Cheng Yishi of Pingyuan, and the like—and the emperor all accepted and employed them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor began to handle government in person. Master of Writing Chen Zhong recommended recluses and upright men—Du Gen of Yingchuan, Cheng Yishi of Pingyuan, and the like—and the emperor accepted and employed them all.

sentences.zh: 忠，寵之子也。

translations.literal: Zhong was the son of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong was Chen Chong's son.

sentences.zh: 初，鄧太后臨朝，根為郎中，與同時郎上書言：「帝年長，宜親政事。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Empress Dowager Deng held court, Gen was a gentleman of the palace and with fellow gentlemen at the time submitted a memorial saying, "The emperor is grown; he ought to handle government in person.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Empress Dowager Deng held court, Gen was a palace gentleman and with fellow gentlemen submitted a memorial saying, "The emperor is grown; he ought to handle government in person."

sentences.zh: 」太后大怒，皆令盛以縑囊，於殿上撲殺之，既而載出城外，根得蘇；

translations.literal: " The empress dowager was greatly angry and had them all packed in silk bags and beaten to death on the hall; afterward they were loaded out beyond the city wall—Gen revived;
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager was greatly angry and had them packed in silk bags and beaten to death in the hall. Afterward they were loaded beyond the city wall. Gen revived;

sentences.zh: 太后使人檢視，根遂詐死，三日，目中生蛆，因得逃竄，為宜城山中酒家保，積十五年。

translations.literal: the empress dowager sent men to inspect; Gen then feigned death—after three days maggots grew in his eyes—and thus escaped, becoming a tavern keeper in the mountains of Yicheng for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager sent men to inspect. Gen feigned death; after three days maggots grew in his eyes, and he escaped to serve as a tavern keeper in the mountains of Yicheng for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 成翊世以郡吏亦坐諫太后不歸政抵罪。

translations.literal: Cheng Yishi as a commandery clerk also sat for the crime of remonstrating that the empress dowager did not return government.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yishi as a commandery clerk was also punished for remonstrating that the empress dowager did not return government.

sentences.zh: 帝皆征詣公車，拜根侍御史，翊世尚書郎。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned them all to the imperial carriage office; Gen was appointed Palace Attendant, Yishi Master of Writing Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned them all to the imperial carriage office, appointed Gen Palace Attendant, and Yishi Master of Writing Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 或問根曰：「往者遇禍，天下同義，知故不少，何至自苦如此？

translations.literal: Someone asked Gen, "When you met calamity before, all under Heaven shared the same cause and acquaintances were not few—why go to such self-torment?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked Gen, "When you met calamity before, sympathizers were not few. Why torment yourself so?"

sentences.zh: 」根曰：「周旋民間，非絕跡之處，邂逅發露，禍及親知，故不為也。

translations.literal: " Gen said, "Moving among the common folk is not a place of utterly vanishing tracks; if by chance one is exposed, calamity reaches kin and acquaintances—therefore I did not do it."
translations.idiomatic: " Gen said, "Moving among the common folk is not utterly vanishing. If by chance one is exposed, calamity reaches kin and friends. Therefore I did not."

sentences.zh: 戊申，追尊清河孝王曰孝德皇，皇妣左氏曰孝德後，祖妣宋貴人曰敬隱後。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Prince Xiao of Qinghe was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaode, his mother the Lady Zuo as Empress Xiaode, and his grandmother the Honored Lady Song as Empress Jingyin.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Prince Xiao of Qinghe was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaode, his mother Lady Zuo as Empress Xiaode, and his grandmother Honored Lady Song as Empress Jingyin.

sentences.zh: 初，長樂太僕蔡倫受竇後諷旨誣陷宋貴人，帝敕使自致延尉，倫飲藥死。

translations.literal: Earlier, Grand Coachman of Changle Cai Lun, receiving Empress Dou's insinuation, falsely charged and trapped Honored Lady Song; the emperor ordered him to present himself to the Commandant of Justice, and Lun drank poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Grand Coachman of Changle Cai Lun, at Empress Dou's instigation, falsely charged Honored Lady Song. The emperor ordered him to present himself to the Commandant of Justice, and Lun drank poison and died.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，高句麗復與鮮卑入寇遼東，蔡諷追擊於新昌，戰歿。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Goguryeo again with the Xianbei entered and raided Liaodong; Cai Feng pursued and struck them at Xinchang and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Goguryeo again entered with the Xianbei and raided Liaodong. Cai Feng pursued them at Xinchang and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 功曹掾龍端、兵馬掾公孫酺以身扞諷，俱沒於陳。

translations.literal: Registrar of Merit Long Duan and Registrar of Troops and Horses Gongsun Pu used their bodies to shield Feng and both perished in the formation.
translations.idiomatic: Registrar of Merit Long Duan and Registrar of Troops and Horses Gongsun Pu shielded Feng with their bodies and both perished in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，尊帝嫡母耿姬為甘陵大貴人。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the emperor's principal mother Lady Geng was honored as Grand Honored Person of Ganling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the emperor's principal mother Lady Geng was honored as Grand Honored Person of Ganling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，樂成王萇坐驕淫不法，貶為蕪湖侯。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Prince Chang of Yuecheng sat for arrogant debauchery and lawlessness and was demoted to Marquis of Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Prince Chang of Yuecheng, for arrogant debauchery and lawlessness, was demoted to Marquis of Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，令公卿下至郡國守相各舉有道之士一人。

translations.literal: On jisi day, an order went from the excellencies and ministers down to commandery and kingdom administrators and chancellors, each to recommend one man of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, an order went from the excellencies and ministers down to commandery and kingdom administrators and chancellors, each to recommend one man of the Way.

sentences.zh: 尚書陳忠以詔書既開諫爭，慮言事者必多激切，或致不能容，乃上疏豫通廣帝意曰：「臣聞仁君廣山藪之大，納切直之謀，忠臣盡謇諤之節，不畏逆耳之害，是以高祖捨周昌桀、紂之譬，孝文嘉袁盎人豕之譏，武帝納東方朔宣室之正，元帝容薛廣德自刎之切。

translations.literal: Master of Writing Chen Zhong, because the edict had already opened remonstrance and dispute, feared memorialists would be many and cutting and might lead to intolerance, and therefore submitted a memorial beforehand to broaden the emperor's intent, saying, "Your servant has heard that a benevolent ruler broadens the greatness of mountains and marshes and accepts cutting, straight counsel; loyal ministers exhaust their blunt, admonishing integrity and do not fear harm to the ears—therefore Gaozu set aside Zhou Chang's comparison to Jie and Zhou, Emperor Wen praised Yuan Ang's rebuke of human swine, Emperor Wu accepted Dongfang Shuo's correction in the Xuan Chamber, and Emperor Yuan tolerated Xue Guangde's cutting plea of self-decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Master of Writing Chen Zhong, because the edict had opened remonstrance, feared memorialists would be cutting and might not be tolerated, and submitted a memorial beforehand to broaden the emperor's intent: "Your servant has heard that a benevolent ruler broadens his scope and accepts blunt counsel; loyal ministers exhaust their integrity and do not fear unwelcome words. Therefore Gaozu set aside Zhou Chang's comparison to Jie and Zhou, Emperor Wen praised Yuan Ang's rebuke of human swine, Emperor Wu accepted Dongfang Shuo's correction in the Xuan Chamber, and Emperor Yuan tolerated Xue Guangde's plea of self-decapitation."

sentences.zh: 今明詔崇高宗之德，推宋景之誠，引咎克躬，諮訪群吏。

translations.literal: Now the bright edict exalts the virtue of honoring the ancestral temple, promotes Song Jing's sincerity, draws blame upon oneself and restrains the person, and consults the host of officials.
translations.idiomatic: Now the bright edict exalts honoring the ancestral temple, promotes Song Jing's sincerity, draws blame upon oneself, and consults officials."

sentences.zh: 言事者見杜根、成翊世等新蒙表錄，顯列二台，必承風響應，爭為切直。

translations.literal: Memorialists seeing Du Gen, Cheng Yishi, and others newly favored with records and manifest on the Two Terraces will surely catch the wind and respond, competing to be cutting and straight.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists seeing Du Gen, Cheng Yishi, and others newly honored and placed on the Two Terraces will surely respond in kind, competing to be blunt."

sentences.zh: 若嘉謀異策，宜輒納用；

translations.literal: If there are fine plans and unusual policies, they ought at once to be accepted and used;
translations.idiomatic: If there are fine plans and unusual policies, they ought at once to be accepted;"

sentences.zh: 如其管穴，妄有譏刺，雖苦口逆耳，不得事實，且優遊寬容，以示聖朝無諱之美；

translations.literal: if like a narrow tube they recklessly have ridicule and censure, though bitter to the mouth and contrary to the ear and not attaining fact, still be leisurely and tolerant to display the holy court's beauty of no taboo;
translations.idiomatic: if like narrow tubes they recklessly ridicule, though bitter and contrary to the ear and not attaining fact, still be leisurely and tolerant to display the holy court's freedom from taboo;"

sentences.zh: 若有道之士對問高者，宜垂省覽，特遷一等，以廣直言之路。

translations.literal: if there are men of the Way whose answers in audience are lofty, they ought to be specially examined and exceptionally promoted one grade to broaden the road of straight speech."
translations.idiomatic: if there are men of the Way whose answers in audience are lofty, they ought to be specially examined and promoted one grade to broaden the road of straight speech."

sentences.zh: 」書御，有詔，拜有道高第士沛國施延為侍中。

translations.literal: " The memorial reached the emperor; there was an edict appointing Shi Yan of Pei, a man of the Way of high rank, as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial reached the emperor. An edict appointed Shi Yan of Pei, a man of the Way of high rank, as Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 初，汝南薛包，少有至行，父娶後妻而憎包，分出之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xue Bao of Runan in youth had utmost conduct; his father took a later wife who hated Bao and sent him out separately.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xue Bao of Runan in youth had utmost conduct. His father took a later wife who hated Bao and sent him out separately.

sentences.zh: 包日夜號泣，不能去，至被驅撲，不得已，廬於捨外，旦入灑掃。

translations.literal: Bao wept and wailed day and night and could not leave; he was even driven and beaten; having no choice, he built a hut outside the dwelling and each dawn entered to sprinkle and sweep.
translations.idiomatic: Bao wept day and night and could not leave. He was even driven and beaten. Having no choice, he built a hut outside the dwelling and each dawn entered to sweep.

sentences.zh: 父怒，又逐之，乃廬於里門，昏晨不廢。

translations.literal: His father was angry and drove him out again; he then built a hut at the lane gate, not ceasing morning or evening.
translations.idiomatic: His father was angry and drove him out again. He built a hut at the lane gate and did not cease morning or evening.

sentences.zh: 積歲餘，父母慚而還之。

translations.literal: After more than a year his parents were ashamed and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year his parents were ashamed and brought him back.

sentences.zh: 及父母亡，弟子求分財異居。

translations.literal: When his parents died, his younger brothers asked to divide property and live separately.
translations.idiomatic: When his parents died, his younger brothers asked to divide property and live separately.

sentences.zh: 包不能止，乃中分其財，奴婢引其老者，曰：「與我共事久，若不能使也。

translations.literal: Bao could not stop them and therefore divided the wealth in half; of the male and female servants he took the old ones, saying, "You have long served with me; I cannot make you serve others."
translations.idiomatic: Bao could not stop them and divided the wealth in half. Of the servants he took the old ones, saying, "You have long served with me; I cannot make you serve others."

sentences.zh: 」田廬取其荒頓者，曰：「吾少時所治，意所戀也。

translations.literal: " Of fields and huts he took the barren and exhausted, saying, "What I tended in my youth is what my heart is attached to."
translations.idiomatic: " Of fields and huts he took the barren plots, saying, "What I tended in my youth is what my heart is attached to."

sentences.zh: 」器物取朽敗者，曰：「我素所服食，身口所安也。

translations.literal: " Of utensils he took the rotten and broken, saying, "What I have always worn and eaten is what my body and mouth are at ease with."
translations.idiomatic: " Of utensils he took the worn and broken, saying, "What I have always worn and eaten is what my body is used to."

sentences.zh: 」弟子數破其產，輒復賑給。

translations.literal: " His younger brothers several times ruined their property, and he repeatedly relieved and supplied them.
translations.idiomatic: " His younger brothers several times ruined their property, and he repeatedly supplied them.

sentences.zh: 帝聞其名，令公車特徵，至，拜侍中。

translations.literal: The emperor heard his name and ordered a special summons by the imperial carriage office; when he arrived, he was appointed Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard his name and ordered a special summons. When he arrived, he was appointed Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 包以死自乞，有詔賜告歸，加禮如毛義。

translations.literal: Bao begged with his life to decline; there was an edict granting leave to return, with added honors like Mao Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Bao begged with his life to decline. An edict granted leave to return with honors like Mao Yi.

sentences.zh: 帝少號聰明，故鄧太后立之。

translations.literal: The emperor in youth was called clever, and therefore Empress Dowager Deng established him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in youth was called clever, and therefore Empress Dowager Deng established him.

sentences.zh: 及長，多不德，稍不可太后意；

translations.literal: When he grew up he had many faults in virtue and gradually did not suit the empress dowager's intent;
translations.idiomatic: When he grew up he had many moral faults and gradually did not suit the empress dowager's intent;

sentences.zh: 帝乳母王聖知之。

translations.literal: the emperor's wet nurse Wang Sheng knew it.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's wet nurse Wang Sheng knew it.

sentences.zh: 太后征濟北、河間王子詣京師，河間王子冀美容儀，太后奇之，以為平原懷王后，留京師。

translations.literal: The empress dowager summoned princes of Jibei and Hejian to the capital; Prince Yi of Hejian had handsome bearing—the empress dowager marveled at him, made him successor to the late Prince Huai of Pingyuan, and kept him at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager summoned princes of Jibei and Hejian to the capital. Prince Yi of Hejian had handsome bearing. The empress dowager marveled at him, made him successor to the late Prince Huai of Pingyuan, and kept him at the capital.

sentences.zh: 王聖見太后久不歸政，慮有廢置，常與中黃門李閏、江京候伺左右，共毀短太后於帝，帝每懷忿懼。

translations.literal: Wang Sheng, seeing the empress dowager long did not return government, feared there would be deposition and replacement; she constantly with Central Yellow Gate Li Run and Jiang Jing watched and waited at the emperor's side, together slandering the empress dowager to the emperor—the emperor each time harbored resentment and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sheng, seeing the empress dowager long did not return government, feared deposition. She constantly with Central Yellow Gate Li Run and Jiang Jing watched at the emperor's side and slandered the empress dowager to him. The emperor each time harbored resentment and fear.

sentences.zh: 及太后崩，宮人先有受罰者懷怨恚，因誣告太后兄弟悝、弘、閶先從尚書鄧訪取廢帝故事，謀立平原王。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died, a palace woman who had earlier been punished bore resentment and thereupon falsely reported that the empress dowager's brothers Kui, Hong, and Chang had first obtained from Master of Writing Deng Fang the precedents for deposing an emperor and plotted to establish the Prince of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died, a palace woman who had earlier been punished bore resentment and falsely reported that the empress dowager's brothers Kui, Hong, and Chang had obtained from Master of Writing Deng Fang precedents for deposing an emperor and plotted to establish the Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，追怒，今有司奏悝等大逆無道，遂廢西平侯廣宗、葉侯廣德、西華侯忠、陽安侯珍、都鄉侯甫德皆為庶人，鄧騭以不與謀，但免特進，遣就國；

translations.literal: The emperor heard and pursued his anger; he ordered the authorities to memorialize that Kui and others were guilty of great rebellion and lawlessness; thereupon Marquis Guangzong of Xiping, Marquis Guangde of Ye, Marquis Zhong of Xihua, Marquis Zhen of Yang'an, and Marquis Fude of Duxiang were all made commoners. Deng Zhi, because he did not join the plot, was only dismissed from special advancement and sent to his state;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and pursued his anger. He ordered the authorities to memorialize that Kui and others were guilty of great rebellion. Marquis Guangzong of Xiping, Marquis Guangde of Ye, Marquis Zhong of Xihua, Marquis Zhen of Yang'an, and Marquis Fude of Duxiang were all made commoners. Deng Zhi, not having joined the plot, was only dismissed from special advancement and sent to his state;

sentences.zh: 宗族免官歸故郡，沒入騭等貲財田宅。

translations.literal: the clan kindred were dismissed from office and returned to their former commanderies; Zhi's and others' wealth, goods, fields, and dwellings were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: clan kindred were dismissed and returned to their former commanderies. Zhi's and others' wealth, goods, fields, and dwellings were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 徙鄧訪及家屬於遠郡，郡縣逼迫，廣宗及忠皆自殺。

translations.literal: Deng Fang and his household were relocated to a distant commandery; the commandery and county pressed them—Guangzong and Zhong both killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Fang and his household were relocated to a distant commandery. Under pressure from commandery and county, Guangzong and Zhong both killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 又徙封騭為羅侯；

translations.literal: Zhi was again moved and enfeoffed as Marquis of Luo;
translations.idiomatic: Zhi was again moved and enfeoffed as Marquis of Luo;

sentences.zh: 五月，庚辰，騭與子鳳並不食而死。

translations.literal: in the fifth month, on gengchen day, Zhi and his son Feng both died from refusing food.
translations.idiomatic: in the fifth month, on gengchen day, Zhi and his son Feng both died from refusing food.

sentences.zh: 騭從弟河南尹豹、度遼將軍舞陽侯遵、將作大匠暢皆自殺；

translations.literal: Zhi's cousin by the mother's side Administrator of Henan Bao, Colonel Who Crosses the Liao Marquis Zun of Wuyang, and Master of Works Chang all killed themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Zhi's maternal cousin Administrator of Henan Bao, Colonel Who Crosses the Liao Marquis Zun of Wuyang, and Master of Works Chang all killed themselves;

sentences.zh: 唯廣德兄弟以母與閻後同產，得留京師。

translations.literal: only Guangde and his brothers, because their mother was born of the same womb as Empress Yan, were allowed to remain at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: only Guangde and his brothers, because their mother was uterine sister to Empress Yan, were allowed to remain at the capital.

sentences.zh: 復以耿夔為度遼將軍，征樂安侯鄧康為太僕。

translations.literal: Geng Kui was again made Colonel Who Crosses the Liao; Marquis Kang of Le'an was summoned as Grand Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Kui was again made Colonel Who Crosses the Liao, and Marquis Kang of Le'an was summoned as Grand Coachman.

sentences.zh: 丙申，貶平原王翼為都鄉侯，譴歸河間。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Prince Yi of Pingyuan was demoted to Marquis of Duxiang and rebuked back to Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Prince Yi of Pingyuan was demoted to Marquis of Duxiang and sent back to Hejian under rebuke.

sentences.zh: 翼謝絕賓客，閉門自守，由是得免。

translations.literal: Yi declined and cut off guests, closed his gate and kept to himself, and thereby escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yi declined guests, closed his gate and kept to himself, and thereby escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 初，鄧後之立也，太尉張禹、司徒徐防欲與司空陳寵共奏追封後父訓，寵以先世無奏請故事，爭之，連日不能奪。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Empress Deng was established, Grand Commandant Zhang Yu and Minister over the Masses Xu Fang wished with Minister of Works Chen Chong jointly to memorialize posthumous enfeoffment of the empress's father Xun; Chong because former ages had no precedent of such a memorial request contested it, and for successive days could not be overborne.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Empress Deng was established, Grand Commandant Zhang Yu and Minister over the Masses Xu Fang wished with Minister of Works Chen Chong jointly to memorialize posthumous enfeoffment of the empress's father Xun. Chong contested that former ages had no such precedent, and for successive days could not be overborne.

sentences.zh: 及訓追加封謚，禹、防復約寵俱遣子奉禮於虎賁中郎將騭，寵不從，故寵子忠不得志於鄧氏。

translations.literal: When Xun received additional posthumous enfeoffment and posthumous title, Yu and Fang again agreed with Chong to send their sons together to present ritual to Colonel of the Rapid Tiger Deng Zhi; Chong did not follow, and therefore Chong's son Zhong could not fulfill his ambitions with the Deng clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun received additional posthumous enfeoffment and title, Yu and Fang again agreed with Chong to send their sons to present ritual to Colonel of the Rapid Tiger Deng Zhi. Chong did not follow, and therefore Chong's son Zhong could not advance with the Deng clan.

sentences.zh: 騭等敗，忠為尚書，數上疏陷成其惡。

translations.literal: When Zhi and others fell, Zhong as Master of Writing several times submitted memorials to trap and complete their evil.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhi and others fell, Zhong as Master of Writing several times submitted memorials to trap and complete their ruin.

sentences.zh: 大司農京兆朱寵痛騭無罪遇禍，乃肉袒輿櫬上疏曰：「伏惟和熹皇后聖善之德，為漢文母。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhu Chong of Jingzhao, grieved that Bi was innocent yet met disaster, stripped to the waist and carried coffin wood to submit a memorial, saying: "I humbly consider that Empress Hexi's sagely goodness made her a mother to Han as Wen's mother was."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhu Chong of Jingzhao, grieved that Deng Bi was innocent yet met disaster, stripped to the waist and carried coffin wood to submit a memorial, saying, "I humbly consider that Empress Hexi's sagely goodness made her a mother to Han as Empress Wen's mother was."

sentences.zh: 兄弟忠孝，同心憂國，宗廟有主，王室是賴。

translations.literal: The brothers were loyal and filial, of one mind in worrying for the state; the ancestral temple had its lord, and the royal house relied on them.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers were loyal and filial, of one mind in worrying for the state. The ancestral temple had its lord, and the royal house relied on them.

sentences.zh: 功成身退，讓國遜位，歷世外戚，無與為比，當享積善履謙祐。

translations.literal: When their work was done they withdrew, yielding the realm and declining rank; among consort kin of successive ages none could compare—they should have enjoyed the blessings of accumulated goodness and practiced humility.
translations.idiomatic: When their work was done they withdrew, yielding the realm and declining rank. Among consort kin of successive ages none could compare—they should have enjoyed the blessings of accumulated goodness and practiced humility.

sentences.zh: 而橫為宮人單辭所陷，利口傾險，反亂國家，罪無申證，獄不訊鞫，遂令騭等罹此酷濫，一門七人，並不以命，屍骸流離，冤魂不反，逆天感人，率土喪氣。

translations.literal: Yet they were wantonly trapped by palace women's one-sided words; glib tongues overturned and harmed, and the state was thrown into disorder. Crimes had no proof, prisons held no interrogation, and so Bi and others suffered this cruel excess—seven of one household all lost their lives, corpses scattered abroad, wronged souls not returned; it moved Heaven against nature and drained morale throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they were wantonly trapped by palace women's one-sided words. Glib tongues overturned and harmed, and the state was thrown into disorder. Crimes had no proof and prisons held no interrogation, and so Deng Bi and others suffered this cruel excess—seven of one household all lost their lives, corpses scattered abroad, wronged souls not returned. It moved Heaven against nature and drained morale throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 宜收還塚次，寵樹遺孤，奉承血祀，以謝亡靈。

translations.literal: Their tombs should be restored, orphans favored and established, blood sacrifices maintained, to appease the departed spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Their tombs should be restored, orphans favored and established, and blood sacrifices maintained, to appease the departed spirits.

sentences.zh: 」寵知其言切，自致廷尉；

translations.literal: " Knowing his words were sharp, Chong surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice;
translations.idiomatic: " Knowing his words were sharp, Zhu Chong surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice;

sentences.zh: 陳忠復劾奏寵，詔免官歸田裡。

translations.literal: Chen Zhong again impeached and memorialized against Chong; an edict dismissed him from office and sent him home to his fields.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhong again impeached and memorialized against Zhu Chong. An edict dismissed him from office and sent him home to his fields.

sentences.zh: 眾庶多為騭稱枉者，帝意頗悟，乃譴讓州郡，還葬騭等於北芒，諸從昆弟皆得歸京師。
