translations.literal: The common people widely called Bi's case unjust; the emperor's mind was somewhat awakened, and he reproved the provinces and commanderies, had Bi and others reburied at Beimang, and all the collateral brothers were allowed to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The common people widely called Deng Bi's case unjust. The emperor's mind was somewhat awakened, and he reproved the provinces and commanderies, had Bi and others reburied at Beimang, and all the collateral brothers were allowed to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝以耿貴人兄牟平侯寶監羽林左軍車騎，封宋楊四子皆為列侯，宋氏為卿、校、侍中大夫、謁者、郎吏十餘人；

translations.literal: The emperor made the Noble Lady Geng's elder brother, Marquis of Mouping Bao, oversee Chariots and Cavalry of the Left Wing of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed all four sons of Song Yang as ranked marquises, and more than ten of the Song clan became ministers, commandants, Palace Attendants, Grandees, ushers, and gentleman clerks;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made the Noble Lady Geng's elder brother, Marquis of Mouping Bao, oversee Chariots and Cavalry of the Left Wing of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed all four sons of Song Yang as ranked marquises, and more than ten of the Song clan became ministers, commandants, Palace Attendants, Grandees, ushers, and gentleman clerks;

sentences.zh: 閻皇后兄弟顯、景、耀，並為卿、校，典禁兵。

translations.literal: Empress Yan's brothers Xian, Jing, and Yao were all ministers and commandants in charge of the forbidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yan's brothers Xian, Jing, and Yao were all ministers and commandants in charge of the forbidden troops.

sentences.zh: 於是內寵始盛。

translations.literal: From this inner favorites first flourished.
translations.idiomatic: From this, inner favorites first flourished.

sentences.zh: 帝以江京嘗迎帝於邸，以為京功，封都鄉侯，封李閏為雍鄉侯，閏、京並遷中常侍，京兼大長秋，與中常侍樊豐、黃門令劉安、鉤盾令陳達及王聖、聖女伯榮扇動內外，競為侈虐；

translations.literal: Because Jiang Jing had once received the emperor at his residence, the emperor considered it Jing's merit and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Duxiang, enfeoffed Li Run as Marquis of Yongxiang; Run and Jing were both promoted to Regular Palace Attendant, Jing also holding Grand Director of the Long Autumn, and with Regular Palace Attendant Fan Feng, Yellow Gate Director Liu An, Hook-Shield Director Chen Da, and Wang Sheng and Sheng's daughter Bo Rong they stirred inside and outside, each vying in extravagance and cruelty;
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiang Jing had once received the emperor at his residence, the emperor considered it Jing's merit and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Duxiang and enfeoffed Li Run as Marquis of Yongxiang. Run and Jing were both promoted to Regular Palace Attendant, with Jing also holding Grand Director of the Long Autumn. Together with Regular Palace Attendant Fan Feng, Yellow Gate Director Liu An, Hook-Shield Director Chen Da, and Wang Sheng and Sheng's daughter Bo Rong they stirred inside and outside, each vying in extravagance and cruelty;

sentences.zh: 伯榮出入宮掖，傳通姦賂。

translations.literal: Bo Rong went in and out of the inner palace quarters and conveyed bribes for illicit dealings.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Rong went in and out of the inner palace quarters and conveyed bribes for illicit dealings.

sentences.zh: 司徒楊震上疏曰：「臣聞政以得賢為本，治以去穢為務；

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yang Zhen submitted a memorial, saying: "I have heard that government takes gaining the worthy as its root and administration takes removing the foul as its task;"
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yang Zhen submitted a memorial, saying, "I have heard that government takes gaining the worthy as its root and administration takes removing the foul as its task;"

sentences.zh: 是以唐、虞俊乂在官，四凶流放，天下咸服，以致雍熙。

translations.literal: "therefore Tang and Yu had outstanding men in office, the Four Evils were exiled, all under heaven submitted, and there was great harmony."
translations.idiomatic: "therefore Tang and Yu had outstanding men in office, the Four Evils were exiled, all under heaven submitted, and there was great harmony."

sentences.zh: 方今九德未事，嬖倖充庭。

translations.literal: "Now the nine virtues are not practiced and favorites fill the court."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the nine virtues are not practiced and favorites fill the court."

sentences.zh: 阿母王聖，出自賤微，得遭千載，奉養聖躬，雖有推燥居濕之勤，前後賞惠，過報勞苦，而無厭之心不知紀極，外交屬托，擾亂天下，損辱清朝，塵點日月。

translations.literal: "Nurse-mother Wang Sheng came from base origins yet met this once-in-a-thousand age to nurture the sacred person. Though she had the toil of moving the dry [bedding] to the damp, rewards before and after overpaid her labor—yet her heart without satiety knows no limit; she maintains outside connections and patronage, disturbs all under heaven, shames the pure court, and stains sun and moon."
translations.idiomatic: "Nurse-mother Wang Sheng came from base origins yet met this once-in-a-thousand age to nurture the sacred person. Though she had the toil of moving the dry bedding to the damp, rewards before and after overpaid her labor—yet her heart without satiety knows no limit. She maintains outside connections and patronage, disturbs all under heaven, shames the pure court, and stains sun and moon."

sentences.zh: 夫女子、小人，近之喜，遠之怨，實為難養。

translations.literal: "Women and petty men—drawn near they are pleased, sent away they resent—it is truly hard to keep them."
translations.idiomatic: "Women and petty men—drawn near they are pleased, sent away they resent—it is truly hard to keep them."

sentences.zh: 宜速出阿母，令居外捨，斷絕伯榮，莫使往來。

translations.literal: "The nurse-mother should quickly be sent out to dwell in an outer lodge, and Bo Rong cut off so she may not come and go."
translations.idiomatic: "The nurse-mother should quickly be sent out to dwell in an outer lodge, and Bo Rong cut off so she may not come and go."

sentences.zh: 令恩德兩隆，上下俱美。

translations.literal: "Let favor and virtue both rise high, and upper and lower alike be beautiful."
translations.idiomatic: "Let favor and virtue both rise high, and upper and lower alike be beautiful."

sentences.zh: 」奏御，帝以示阿母等，內幸皆懷忿恚。

translations.literal: " The memorial was presented; the emperor showed it to the nurse-mother and others, and the inner favorites all harbored anger.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was presented. The emperor showed it to the nurse-mother and others, and the inner favorites all harbored anger.

sentences.zh: 而伯榮驕淫尤甚，通於故朝陽侯劉護從兄瑰，瑰遂以為妻，官至侍中，得襲護爵。

translations.literal: Bo Rong's arrogance and debauchery were especially extreme; she had relations with Gui, a cousin of the former Marquis of Chaoyang Liu Hu, and Gui then took her as wife, rose to Palace Attendant, and succeeded to Hu's marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Rong's arrogance and debauchery were especially extreme. She had relations with Gui, a cousin of the former Marquis of Chaoyang Liu Hu, and Gui then took her as wife, rose to Palace Attendant, and succeeded to Hu's marquisate.

sentences.zh: 震上疏曰：「經制，父死子繼，兄亡弟及，以防篡也。

translations.literal: Zhen submitted a memorial, saying: "The canonical system: when the father dies the son succeeds, when the elder brother dies the younger brother follows—to guard against usurpation."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen submitted a memorial, saying, "The canonical system: when the father dies the son succeeds, when the elder brother dies the younger brother follows—to guard against usurpation."

sentences.zh: 伏見詔書，封故朝陽侯劉護再從兄瑰襲護爵為侯；

translations.literal: "I humbly see in the edict that Gui, a second cousin of the former Marquis of Chaoyang Liu Hu, is enfeoffed to succeed Hu's marquisate as marquis;"
translations.idiomatic: "I humbly see in the edict that Gui, a second cousin of the former Marquis of Chaoyang Liu Hu, is enfeoffed to succeed Hu's marquisate as marquis;"

sentences.zh: 護同產弟威，今猶見在。

translations.literal: "Hu's full younger brother Wei is still alive."
translations.idiomatic: "Hu's full younger brother Wei is still alive."

sentences.zh: 臣聞天子專封，封有功；

translations.literal: "I have heard that the Son of Heaven alone enfeoffs, and enfeoffment is for those with merit;"
translations.idiomatic: "I have heard that the Son of Heaven alone enfeoffs, and enfeoffment is for those with merit;"

sentences.zh: 諸侯專爵，爵有德。

translations.literal: "feudal lords alone grant ranks, and rank is for the virtuous."
translations.idiomatic: "feudal lords alone grant ranks, and rank is for the virtuous."

sentences.zh: 今瑰無佗功行，但以配阿母女，一時之間，既位侍中，又至封侯，不稽舊制，不合經義，行人喧嘩，百姓不安。

translations.literal: "Now Gui has no other merit or conduct—he is enfeoffed only for marrying the nurse-mother's daughter. In a single moment he is both Palace Attendant and enfeoffed as marquis, without examining the old system or conforming to canonical meaning. Travelers clamor and the people are unsettled."
translations.idiomatic: "Now Gui has no other merit or conduct—he is enfeoffed only for marrying the nurse-mother's daughter. In a single moment he is both Palace Attendant and enfeoffed as marquis, without examining the old system or conforming to canonical meaning. Travelers clamor and the people are unsettled."

sentences.zh: 陛下宜鑒鏡既往，順帝之則。

translations.literal: "Your Majesty should take the past as a mirror and follow the emperor's norm."
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty should take the past as a mirror and follow the emperor's norm."

sentences.zh: 」尚書廣陵翟瑰上疏曰：「昔竇、鄧之寵，傾動四方，兼官重紱，盈金積貨，至使議弄神器，改更社稷，豈不以勢尊威廣以致斯患乎！

translations.literal: " Director of the Masters of Writing Zhai Gui of Guangling submitted a memorial, saying: "In former times the favor shown Dou and Deng shook the four quarters; they held multiple offices and heavy seals, amassed gold and hoarded goods, until some plotted to toy with the sacred vessel and alter the altars of soil and grain—is it not because towering power and broad authority brought such calamity!"
translations.idiomatic: " Director of the Masters of Writing Zhai Gui of Guangling submitted a memorial, saying, "In former times the favor shown the Dou and Deng clans shook the four quarters. They held multiple offices and heavy seals, amassed gold and hoarded goods, until some plotted to toy with the sacred vessel and alter the altars of soil and grain—is it not because towering power and broad authority brought such calamity!"

sentences.zh: 及其破壞，頭顙墮地，願為孤豚，豈可得哉！

translations.literal: "When they were destroyed their heads fell to the ground; to wish to be a lone piglet—how could that be obtained!"
translations.idiomatic: "When they were destroyed their heads fell to the ground. To wish to be a lone piglet—how could that be obtained!"

sentences.zh: 夫致貴無漸，失必暴；

translations.literal: "Attaining nobility without gradual steps, loss is sure to be sudden;"
translations.idiomatic: "Attaining nobility without gradual steps, loss is sure to be sudden;"

sentences.zh: 受爵非道，殃必疾。

translations.literal: "receiving rank by an improper path, disaster is sure to be swift."
translations.idiomatic: "receiving rank by an improper path, disaster is sure to be swift."

sentences.zh: 今外戚寵幸，功均造化，漢元以來未有等比。

translations.literal: "Now consort kin are favored and blessed, their merit equal to creation and transformation—since Emperor Yuan of Han there has been no parallel."
translations.idiomatic: "Now consort kin are favored and blessed, their merit equal to creation and transformation—since Emperor Yuan of Han there has been no parallel."

sentences.zh: 陛下誠仁恩周洽，以親九族，然祿去公室，政移私門，覆車重尋，寧無摧折！

translations.literal: "Your Majesty is truly benevolent and gracious throughout, treating the nine agnates as kin—yet salaries leave the public house and government shifts to private gates. Overturned carts lie one upon another—will there be no wreck!"
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty is truly benevolent and gracious throughout, treating the nine agnates as kin—yet salaries leave the public house and government shifts to private gates. Overturned carts lie one upon another—will there be no wreck!"

sentences.zh: 此最安危之極戒，社稷之深計也。

translations.literal: "This is the utmost warning of safety and danger, the deep calculation for the altars of soil and grain."
translations.idiomatic: "This is the utmost warning of safety and danger, the deep calculation for the altars of soil and grain."

sentences.zh: 昔文帝愛百金於露台，飾帷帳於皁囊，或有譏其儉者，上曰：『朕為天下守財耳，豈得妄用之哉！

translations.literal: "In former times Emperor Wen cherished a hundred in gold at the terrace in the clouds and trimmed curtains with black-cloth bags; some mocked his frugality, and the emperor said: 'I am guarding wealth for all under heaven—how could I use it recklessly!'
translations.idiomatic: "In former times Emperor Wen cherished a hundred in gold at the terrace in the clouds and trimmed curtains with black-cloth bags. Some mocked his frugality, and the emperor said, 'I am guarding wealth for all under heaven—how could I use it recklessly!'

sentences.zh: 』今自初政已來，日月未久，費用賞賜，已不可算。

translations.literal: "' Now from the beginning of your rule, the sun and moon have not long passed, yet expenses and rewards already cannot be reckoned."
translations.idiomatic: "' Now from the beginning of your rule, the sun and moon have not long passed, yet expenses and rewards already cannot be reckoned."

sentences.zh: 斂天下之財，積無功之家，帑藏單盡，民物雕傷，卒有不虞，復當重賦，百姓怨叛既生，危敵可待也。

translations.literal: "You gather the wealth of all under heaven and heap it on households without merit; the treasury is drained bare and the people and things are worn away. If suddenly there is the unforeseen, heavy levies must again be imposed—popular resentment and rebellion have already arisen, and perilous foes may be awaited."
translations.idiomatic: "You gather the wealth of all under heaven and heap it on households without merit. The treasury is drained bare and the people and things are worn away. If suddenly there is the unforeseen, heavy levies must again be imposed—popular resentment and rebellion have already arisen, and perilous foes may be awaited."

sentences.zh: 願陛下勉求忠貞之臣，誅遠佞諂之黨，割情慾之歡，罷宴私之好，心存亡國所以失之，鑒觀興王所以得之，庶災害可息，豐年可招矣。

translations.literal: "I wish Your Majesty would strive to seek loyal and upright ministers, punish and remove the faction of flatterers, cut off the pleasures of passion, cease private feasting and favor, keep in mind how states perish and take as mirror how rising kings gain the realm—then perhaps disasters may cease and abundant years be summoned."
translations.idiomatic: "I wish Your Majesty would strive to seek loyal and upright ministers, punish and remove the faction of flatterers, cut off the pleasures of passion, and cease private feasting and favor. Keep in mind how states perish and take as mirror how rising kings gain the realm—then perhaps disasters may cease and abundant years be summoned."

sentences.zh: 」書奏，皆不省。

translations.literal: " The memorials were submitted; none were heeded.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorials were submitted; none were heeded.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，己卿，改元，赦天下。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiqing, the era name was changed and all under heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on jiqing day, the era name was changed and all under heaven was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太尉馬英薨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Grand Commandant Ma Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Grand Commandant Ma Ying died.

sentences.zh: 燒當羌忍良等，以麻奴兄弟本燒當世嫡，而校尉馬賢撫恤不至，常有怨心，遂相結，共脅將諸種寇湟中，攻金城諸縣。

translations.literal: Renliang and others of the Shaodang Qiang, because the brothers Manu were the legitimate line of Shaodang for the age yet Commandant Ma Xian's care and comfort did not reach them and they constantly bore resentment, joined together and jointly compelled the various tribes to raid the Huangzhong region and attack the counties of Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Renliang and others of the Shaodang Qiang, because the brothers Manu were the legitimate line of Shaodang for the age yet Commandant Ma Xian's care and comfort did not reach them and they constantly bore resentment, joined together and jointly compelled the various tribes to raid the Huangzhong region and attack the counties of Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 八月，賢將先零種擊之，戰於牧苑，不利。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xian led the Xianling tribe to attack them; they fought at Muyuan and fared ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Ma Xian led the Xianling tribe to attack them. They fought at Muyuan and fared ill.

sentences.zh: 麻奴等又敗武威、張掖郡兵於令居，因脅將先零、沈氐諸種四千餘戶緣山西走，寇武威。

translations.literal: Manu and others again defeated the troops of Wuwei and Zhangye commanderies at Lingju, then compelled the Xianling, Shendi, and other tribes—more than four thousand households—to go west along the mountains and raid Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Manu and others again defeated the troops of Wuwei and Zhangye commanderies at Lingju, then compelled the Xianling, Shendi, and other tribes—more than four thousand households—to go west along the mountains and raid Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 賢追到鸞鳥，招引之，諸種降者數千，麻奴南還湟中。

translations.literal: Xian pursued to Luanniao and summoned them; several thousand of the tribes submitted, and Manu returned south to the Huangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian pursued to Luanniao and summoned them. Several thousand of the tribes submitted, and Manu returned south to the Huangzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前司徒劉愷為太尉。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the former Grand Secretary Liu Kai was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the former Grand Secretary Liu Kai was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 初，清河相叔孫光坐臧抵罪，遂增禁錮二世。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chancellor of Qinghe Shusun Guang was convicted of corruption and punished, and perpetual imprisonment was extended to a second generation.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Chancellor of Qinghe Shusun Guang was convicted of corruption and punished, and perpetual imprisonment was extended to a second generation.

sentences.zh: 至是，居延都尉范邠復犯臧罪，朝廷欲依光比；

translations.literal: At this time Commandant of Juyan Fan Bin again committed corruption; the court wished to follow Guang's precedent;
translations.idiomatic: At this time Commandant of Juyan Fan Bin again committed corruption, and the court wished to follow Guang's precedent;

sentences.zh: 劉愷獨以為：「《春秋》之義，善善及子孫，惡惡止其身，所以進人於善也。

translations.literal: Liu Kai alone held: "The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that goodness to the good extends to descendants, while evil to the evil stops with the person himself—this is how men are advanced toward goodness."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kai alone held, "The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that goodness to the good extends to descendants, while evil to the evil stops with the person himself—this is how men are advanced toward goodness."

sentences.zh: 如今使臧吏禁錮子孫，以輕從重，懼及善人，非先王詳刑之意也。

translations.literal: "To make corrupt officials' descendants suffer perpetual imprisonment, punishing the light by the heavy, is to fear harming good men and is not the intent of the Former Kings' careful punishments."
translations.idiomatic: "To make corrupt officials' descendants suffer perpetual imprisonment, punishing the light by the heavy, is to fear harming good men and is not the intent of the Former Kings' careful punishments."

sentences.zh: 」尚書陳忠亦以為然。

translations.literal: " Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Zhong also thought this correct.
translations.idiomatic: " Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Zhong also thought this correct.

sentences.zh: 有詔：「太尉議是。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Grand Commandant's opinion is correct."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The Grand Commandant's opinion is correct."

sentences.zh: 鮮卑其至鞬寇居庸關。

translations.literal: The Xianbei chanyu Qizhi Jian raided Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei chanyu Qizhi Jian raided Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 九月，雲中太守成嚴擊之，兵敗，功曹楊穆以身捍嚴，與之俱歿；

translations.literal: In the ninth month Administrator of Yunzhong Cheng Yan attacked them; his army was defeated; Registrar Yang Mu used his body to shield Yan and perished with him;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Administrator of Yunzhong Cheng Yan attacked them. His army was defeated. Registrar Yang Mu used his body to shield Yan and perished with him;

sentences.zh: 鮮卑於是圍烏桓校尉徐常於馬城。

translations.literal: the Xianbei thereupon besieged Commandant of the Wuhuan Xu Chang at Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: the Xianbei thereupon besieged Commandant of the Wuhuan Xu Chang at Macheng.

sentences.zh: 度遼將軍耿夔與幽州刺史龐參發廣陽、漁陽、涿郡甲卒救之，鮮卑解去。

translations.literal: General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui and Governor of You Pang Can mobilized armored soldiers of Guangyang, Yuyang, and Zhuo commanderies to rescue them, and the Xianbei withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui and Governor of You Pang Can mobilized armored soldiers of Guangyang, Yuyang, and Zhuo commanderies to rescue them, and the Xianbei withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝幸衛尉馮石府，留飲十許日，賞賜甚厚，拜其子世為黃門侍郎，世弟二人皆為郎中。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the emperor visited the residence of Commandant of the Guards Feng Shi, stayed and drank for some ten days, and bestowed very generous rewards; he appointed Shi's son Shi as Yellow Gate Gentleman Attendant, and Shi's two younger brothers as Gentlemen of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the emperor visited the residence of Commandant of the Guards Feng Shi, stayed and drank for some ten days, and bestowed very generous rewards. He appointed Shi's son Shi as Yellow Gate Gentleman Attendant, and Shi's two younger brothers as Gentlemen of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 石，陽邑侯魴之孫也，父柱尚顯宗女獲嘉公主，石襲公主爵，為獲嘉侯，能取悅當世，故為帝所寵。

translations.literal: Shi was grandson of Marquis of Yangyi Fang; his father Zhu married Emperor Xianzong's daughter Princess Huojia; Shi inherited the princess's rank as Marquis of Huojia, could please the age, and therefore was favored by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shi was grandson of Marquis of Yangyi Fang. His father Zhu married Emperor Xianzong's daughter Princess Huojia. Shi inherited the princess's rank as Marquis of Huojia, could please the age, and therefore was favored by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 京師及郡國二十七雨水。

translations.literal: The capital and twenty-seven commanderies and states had rain and flood.
translations.idiomatic: The capital and twenty-seven commanderies and states had rain and flooding.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，己丑，郡國三十五地震。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on jichou, thirty-five commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on jichou day, thirty-five commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑寇玄菟。

translations.literal: The Xianbei raided Xuantu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei raided Xuantu.

sentences.zh: 尚書令祋諷等奏，以為「孝文皇帝定約禮之制，光武皇帝絕告寧之典，貽則萬世，誠不可改，宜復斷大臣行三年喪。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Di Feng and others memorialized, holding that "Emperor Xiaowen fixed the curtailed rites system, Emperor Guangwu abolished the leave-for-consolation-at-home canon—they bequeathed norms for ten thousand generations and truly cannot be changed; it is fitting again to forbid ministers from observing the three-year mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Masters of Writing Di Feng and others memorialized, holding that "Emperor Xiaowen fixed the curtailed rites system and Emperor Guangwu abolished the leave-for-consolation-at-home canon—they bequeathed norms for ten thousand generations and truly cannot be changed. It is fitting again to forbid ministers from observing the three-year mourning."

sentences.zh: 」尚書陳忠上疏曰：「高祖受命，蕭何創製，大臣有寧告之科，合於致憂之義。

translations.literal: " Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying: "When Gaozu received the Mandate, Xiao He established institutions; ministers had the statute for leave to announce mourning at home, in keeping with the meaning of expressing grief."
translations.idiomatic: " Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying, "When Gaozu received the Mandate, Xiao He established institutions. Ministers had the statute for leave to announce mourning at home, in keeping with the meaning of expressing grief."

sentences.zh: 建武之初，新承大亂，凡諸國政，多趣簡易，大臣既不得告寧而群司營祿念私，鮮循三年之喪以報顧復之恩者，禮義之方，實為雕損。

translations.literal: "At the beginning of Jianwu, newly inheriting great disorder, all state affairs mostly tended toward simplicity; since ministers could not take leave for mourning yet the various offices pursued salaries and thought of private gain, few followed the three-year mourning to repay the grace of nurture and restoration—the direction of ritual and righteousness was truly worn away."
translations.idiomatic: "At the beginning of Jianwu, newly inheriting great disorder, all state affairs mostly tended toward simplicity. Since ministers could not take leave for mourning yet the various offices pursued salaries and thought of private gain, few followed the three-year mourning to repay the grace of nurture and restoration—the direction of ritual and righteousness was truly worn away."

sentences.zh: 陛下聽大臣終喪，聖功美業，靡以尚茲。

translations.literal: "If Your Majesty permits ministers to complete mourning, this sacred achievement and beautiful enterprise has nothing above it."
translations.idiomatic: "If Your Majesty permits ministers to complete mourning, this sacred achievement and beautiful enterprise has nothing above it."

sentences.zh: 《孟子》有言：『老吾老，以及人之老；

translations.literal: "Mencius said: 'Honor my elders, and thereby honor others' elders;'
translations.idiomatic: "Mencius said, 'Honor my elders, and thereby honor others' elders;'

sentences.zh: 幼吾幼，以及人之幼，天下可運如掌。

translations.literal: 'Cherish my young, and thereby cherish others' young, and all under heaven may be moved as in the palm.'"
translations.idiomatic: 'cherish my young, and thereby cherish others' young, and all under heaven may be moved as in the palm.'"

sentences.zh: 』臣願陛下登高北望，以甘陵之思揆度臣子之心，則海內咸得其所。

translations.literal: "' I wish Your Majesty would ascend high and look north, measuring ministers' hearts by the thought of Ganling—then within the seas all would obtain their proper place."
translations.idiomatic: "' I wish Your Majesty would ascend high and look north, measuring ministers' hearts by the thought of Ganling—then within the seas all would obtain their proper place."

sentences.zh: 」時宦官不便之，竟寢忠奏。

translations.literal: " At the time the eunuchs found it inconvenient and in the end shelved Zhong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time the eunuchs found it inconvenient and in the end shelved Chen Zhong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復斷二千石以上行三年喪。

translations.literal: On gengzi, it was again forbidden for officials of two thousand bushels and above to observe the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, it was again forbidden for officials of two thousand bushels and above to observe the three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 袁宏論曰：古之帝王所以篤化美俗，率民為善，因其自然而不奪其情，民猶有不及者，而況毀禮止哀，滅其天性乎！

translations.literal: Yuan Hong remarked: The ancient emperors and kings deepened transformation and beautified custom, leading the people toward goodness by following their nature and not depriving their feelings—yet the people still had those who fell short; how much more when rites are destroyed and mourning stopped and innate feeling extinguished!
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hong remarked: The ancient emperors and kings deepened transformation and beautified custom, leading the people toward goodness by following their nature and not depriving their feelings—yet the people still had those who fell short. How much more when rites are destroyed and mourning stopped and innate feeling extinguished!

sentences.zh: 十二月，高句驪王宮率馬韓、濊貊數千騎圍玄菟，夫餘王遣子尉仇台將二萬餘人與州郡並力討破之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month King Gong of Gaogouli led several thousand horsemen of the Ma Han and Yemaek to besiege Xuantu; the king of Fuyu sent his son Wei Qiutai leading more than twenty thousand men to join the province and commanderies in joint suppression and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month King Gong of Gaogouli led several thousand horsemen of the Ma Han and Yemaek to besiege Xuantu. The king of Fuyu sent his son Wei Qiutai leading more than twenty thousand men to join the province and commanderies in joint suppression and defeat them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，宮死，子遂成立。

translations.literal: That year Gong died and his son Suicheng was established.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gong died and his son Suicheng was established.

sentences.zh: 玄菟太守姚光上言，欲因其喪，發兵擊之，議者皆以為可許。

translations.literal: Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang memorialized, wishing to take advantage of their mourning to send troops and attack; the deliberators all thought it permissible.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang memorialized, wishing to take advantage of their mourning to send troops and attack. The deliberators all thought it permissible.

sentences.zh: 陳忠曰：「宮前桀黠，光不能討，死而擊之，非義也。

translations.literal: Chen Zhong said: "Gong was formerly fierce and cunning; Guang could not subdue him. To attack when he is dead is not righteous."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhong said, "Gong was formerly fierce and cunning and Guang could not subdue him. To attack when he is dead is not righteous."

sentences.zh: 宜遣使弔問，因責讓前罪，赦不加誅，取其後善。

translations.literal: "Envoys should be sent to offer condolences, and thereby reprove past crimes, pardon without execution, and take what goodness comes after."
translations.idiomatic: "Envoys should be sent to offer condolences, and thereby reprove past crimes, pardon without execution, and take what goodness comes after."

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed this.

sentences.zh: 春，三月，丙午，改元，赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the third month, on bingwu, the era name was changed and all under heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the third month, on bingwu day, the era name was changed and all under heaven was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 護羌校尉馬賢追擊麻奴，到湟中，破之，種眾散遁。

translations.literal: Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian pursued Manu to the Huangzhong, defeated him, and the tribal masses scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Protector of the Qiang Ma Xian pursued Manu to the Huangzhong, defeated him, and the tribal masses scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，癸未，京師、郡國二十一雨雹，河西雹大者如斗。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guiwei, the capital and twenty-one commanderies and states had hail; in Hexi the hailstones were as large as a dou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on guiwei day, the capital and twenty-one commanderies and states had hail. In Hexi the hailstones were as large as a dou.

sentences.zh: 幽州刺史馮煥、玄菟太守姚光數糾發奸惡，怨者詐作璽書，譴責煥、光，賜以歐刀，又下遼東都尉龐奮，使速行刑。

translations.literal: Governor of You Feng Huan and Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang repeatedly investigated and exposed wickedness; resentful men forged an imperial-seal document reproving Huan and Guang, bestowing executioner's blades, and also sent orders down to Commandant of Liaodong Pang Fen to carry out punishment swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of You Feng Huan and Administrator of Xuantu Yao Guang repeatedly investigated and exposed wickedness. Resentful men forged an imperial-seal document reproving Huan and Guang, bestowing executioner's blades, and also sent orders down to Commandant of Liaodong Pang Fen to carry out punishment swiftly.

sentences.zh: 奮即斬光，收煥。

translations.literal: Fen immediately beheaded Guang and arrested Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Fen immediately beheaded Yao Guang and arrested Feng Huan.

sentences.zh: 煥欲自殺，其子緄疑詔文有異，止煥曰：「大人在州，志欲去惡，實無它故。

translations.literal: Huan wished to kill himself; his son Gun suspected the edict text was irregular and stopped Huan, saying: "Father, in the province your will was to remove evil; there truly was no other cause."
translations.idiomatic: Feng Huan wished to kill himself. His son Gun suspected the edict text was irregular and stopped him, saying, "Father, in the province your will was to remove evil; there truly was no other cause."

sentences.zh: 必是凶人妄詐，規肆奸毒。

translations.literal: "This must be wicked men falsely forging, plotting to unleash villainy."
translations.idiomatic: "This must be wicked men falsely forging, plotting to unleash villainy."

sentences.zh: 願以事自上，甘罪無晚。

translations.literal: "I wish to take the matter upward to the throne; to accept guilt would not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: "I wish to take the matter upward to the throne; to accept guilt would not be too late."

sentences.zh: 」煥從其言，上書自訟，果詐者所為，征奮，抵罪。

translations.literal: " Huan followed his words, submitted a memorial pleading his own case, and it proved to be the forgers' work; Fen was summoned and punished.
translations.idiomatic: " Feng Huan followed his advice, submitted a memorial pleading his own case, and it proved to be the forgers' work. Pang Fen was summoned and punished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，司空陳褒免。

translations.literal: On guisi, Minister of Works Chen Bao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Minister of Works Chen Bao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五月，庚戌，宗正彭城劉授為司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengxu, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Shou of Pengcheng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Shou of Pengcheng was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 己巳，封河間孝王子德為安平王，嗣樂成靖王后。

translations.literal: On jisi, Prince De, son of the Filial King of Hejian, was enfeoffed as King of Ping'an, succeeding the Late King of Lecheng Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Prince De, son of the Filial King of Hejian, was enfeoffed as King of Ping'an, succeeding the Late King of Lecheng Jing.

sentences.zh: 六月，郡國蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month commanderies and states suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month commanderies and states suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，癸卯，京師及郡國十三地震。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on guimao, the capital and thirteen commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on guimao day, the capital and thirteen commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 高句驪王遂成還漢生口，詣玄菟降，其後濊貊率服，東垂少事。

translations.literal: King Suicheng of Gaogouli returned Han captives, came to Xuantu to submit, and thereafter the Yemaek broadly submitted; the eastern border had fewer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: King Suicheng of Gaogouli returned Han captives, came to Xuantu to submit, and thereafter the Yemaek broadly submitted. The eastern border had fewer affairs.

sentences.zh: 虔人羌與上郡胡反，度遼將軍耿夔擊破之。

translations.literal: The Qianren Qiang rebelled with the Hu of Shang Commandery; General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianren Qiang rebelled with the Hu of Shang Commandery. General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 八月，陽陵園寢火。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the park lodge at Yangling caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the park lodge at Yangling caught fire.

sentences.zh: 九月，甲戌，郡國二十七地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, twenty-seven commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu day, twenty-seven commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑既累殺郡守，膽氣轉盛，控弦數萬騎，冬，十月，復寇雁門、定襄；

translations.literal: The Xianbei, having repeatedly killed commandery administrators, grew ever bolder in spirit; with tens of thousands of bowmen, in winter, the tenth month, they again raided Yanmen and Dingxiang;
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei, having repeatedly killed commandery administrators, grew ever bolder in spirit. With tens of thousands of bowmen, in winter, in the tenth month, they again raided Yanmen and Dingxiang;

sentences.zh: 十一月，寇太原。

translations.literal: in the eleventh month they raided Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: in the eleventh month they raided Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 燒當羌麻奴饑困，將種眾詣漢陽太守耿種降。

translations.literal: Manu of the Shaodang Qiang, pressed by hunger and hardship, led his tribal masses to Administrator of Hanyang Geng Zhong to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Manu of the Shaodang Qiang, pressed by hunger and hardship, led his tribal masses to Administrator of Hanyang Geng Zhong to submit.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師及郡國二十七雨水。

translations.literal: That year the capital and twenty-seven commanderies and states suffered rain floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital and twenty-seven commanderies and states suffered rain floods.

sentences.zh: 帝數遣黃門常侍及中使伯榮往來甘陵，尚書僕射陳忠上疏曰：「今天心未得，隔並屢臻，青、冀之域，淫雨漏河，徐、岱之濱，海水盆溢，兗、豫蝗蝝滋生，荊、揚稻收儉薄，並、涼二州羌戎叛戾，加以百姓不足，府帑虛匱。

translations.literal: The emperor repeatedly sent Regular Attendants of the Yellow Gate and palace envoy Bo Rong back and forth to Ganling. Vice Director of the Secretariat Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying: "Today heaven's mind is not attained; drought and flood repeatedly arrive. In Qing and Ji regions excessive rain leaks the rivers; on the Xu and Dai coasts seawater overflows like a basin. Yan and Yu breed locust larvae; Jing and Yang have meager rice harvests. Bing and Liang provinces' Qiang and Rong rebel; moreover the people lack sufficiency and the treasury is empty and depleted."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly sent Regular Attendants of the Yellow Gate and the palace envoy Bo Rong back and forth to Ganling. Vice Director of the Secretariat Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying, "Today heaven's mind is not attained. Drought and flood repeatedly arrive. In Qing and Ji excessive rain leaks the rivers; on the Xu and Dai coasts seawater overflows like a basin. Yan and Yu breed locust larvae; Jing and Yang have meager rice harvests. In Bing and Liang the Qiang and Rong rebel. Moreover the people lack sufficiency and the treasury is empty and depleted."

sentences.zh: 陛下以不得親奉孝德皇園廟，比遣中使致敬甘陵，朱軒駢馬，相望道路，可謂孝至矣。

translations.literal: " Your Majesty, because you could not personally attend the park temples of Emperor Xiaode, recently sent palace envoys to pay respects at Ganling—vermilion carriages and paired horses filling the roads one after another—this may be called utmost filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: " Your Majesty, because you could not personally attend the park temples of Emperor Xiaode, recently sent palace envoys to pay respects at Ganling—vermilion carriages and paired horses filling the roads one after another—this may be called utmost filial piety."

sentences.zh: 然臣竊聞使者所過，威權翕赫，震動郡縣，王、侯、二千石至為伯榮獨拜車下，發民修道，繕理亭傳，多設儲偫，征役無度，老弱相隨，動有萬計，賂遺僕從，人數百匹，頓踣呼嗟，莫不叩心。

translations.literal: " Yet your servant has heard that where the envoys pass, authority and power blaze forth and shake commanderies and counties. Kings, marquises, and two-thousand-bushel officials even bow alone to Bo Rong beneath his carriage. They mobilize the people to repair roads, mend post stations, and set up many stores—corvée without measure, old and weak following one another, often numbering in the tens of thousands. Bribes to his attendants run to several hundred bolts of silk per man. Collapsed and prostrate, sighing and crying—none fail to strike the heart."
translations.idiomatic: " Yet your servant has heard that where the envoys pass, authority and power blaze forth and shake commanderies and counties. Kings, marquises, and two-thousand-bushel officials even bow alone to Bo Rong beneath his carriage. They mobilize the people to repair roads, mend post stations, and set up many stores—corvée without measure, old and weak following one another, often numbering in the tens of thousands. Bribes to his attendants run to several hundred bolts of silk per man. Collapsed and prostrate, sighing and crying—none fail to strike the heart."

sentences.zh: 河間托叔父之屬，清河有陵廟之尊，及剖符大臣，皆猥為伯榮屈節車下，陛下不問，必以為陛下欲其然也。

translations.literal: " Hejian relies on being of the emperor's uncle's line; Qinghe possesses the dignity of imperial tomb temples; and great ministers holding investiture—all have basely bent their dignity beneath Bo Rong's carriage. If Your Majesty does not inquire, they will surely think Your Majesty wishes it so."
translations.idiomatic: " Hejian relies on being of the emperor's uncle's line; Qinghe possesses the dignity of imperial tomb temples; and great ministers holding investiture—all have basely bent their dignity beneath Bo Rong's carriage. If Your Majesty does not inquire, they will surely think Your Majesty wishes it so."

sentences.zh: 伯榮之威，重於陛下，陛下之柄，在於臣妾，水災之發，必起於此。

translations.literal: " Bo Rong's authority weighs more than Your Majesty's; Your Majesty's handle lies in servants and concubines. The outbreak of flood disaster must arise from this."
translations.idiomatic: " Bo Rong's authority weighs more than Your Majesty's; Your Majesty's handle lies in servants and concubines. The outbreak of flood disaster must arise from this."

sentences.zh: 昔韓嫣托副車之乘，受馳視之使，江都誤為一拜，而嫣受歐刀之誅。

translations.literal: " Formerly Han Yan relied on riding in the deputy carriage and received missions of rapid inspection. Jiangdu erred in bowing once, and Yan received execution by the ou knife."
translations.idiomatic: " Formerly Han Yan relied on riding in the deputy carriage and received missions of rapid inspection. Jiangdu erred in bowing once, and Yan received execution by the ou knife."

sentences.zh: 臣願明主嚴天元之尊，正乾剛之位，不宜復令女使幹錯萬機。

translations.literal: " Your servant wishes the enlightened ruler to make strict the dignity of heaven's origin and rectify the position of qian's firmness—it is not fitting again to let female envoys interfere in the myriad affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant wishes the enlightened ruler to make strict the dignity of heaven's origin and rectify the position of qian's firmness—it is not fitting again to let female envoys interfere in the myriad affairs of state."

sentences.zh: 重察左右，得無石顯洩漏之奸？

translations.literal: " Examine closely those at your side—is there not Shi Xian's treachery of leaking secrets?"
translations.idiomatic: " Examine closely those at your side—is there not Shi Xian's treachery of leaking secrets?"

sentences.zh: 尚書納言，得無趙昌譖崇之詐？

translations.literal: " Among the Secretariat's receiving words—is there not Zhao Chang's fraud of slander and flattery?"
translations.idiomatic: " Among the Secretariat's receiving words—is there not Zhao Chang's fraud of slander and flattery?"

sentences.zh: 公卿大臣，得無朱博阿傅之援？

translations.literal: " Among the public ministers and great officials—is there not Zhu Bo's support of the tutor?"
translations.idiomatic: " Among the public ministers and great officials—is there not Zhu Bo's support of the tutor?"

sentences.zh: 外屬近戚，得無王鳳害商之謀？

translations.literal: " Among outer kin and near relatives—is there not Wang Feng's plot to harm Shang?"
translations.idiomatic: " Among outer kin and near relatives—is there not Wang Feng's plot to harm Shang?"

sentences.zh: 若國政一由帝命，王事每決於己，則下不得逼上，臣不得干君，常雨大水必當霽止，四方眾異不能為害。

translations.literal: " If state affairs all follow the emperor's command and royal business is each decided by yourself, then inferiors cannot press superiors and ministers cannot interfere with the ruler. Constant rain and great floods will surely clear and stop, and the many anomalies of the four quarters cannot do harm."
translations.idiomatic: " If state affairs all follow the emperor's command and royal business is each decided by yourself, then inferiors cannot press superiors and ministers cannot interfere with the ruler. Constant rain and great floods will surely clear and stop, and the many anomalies of the four quarters cannot do harm."

sentences.zh: 」書奏，不省。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted and not heeded.

sentences.zh: 時三府任輕，機事專委尚書，而災眚變咎，輒切免三公，陳忠上疏曰：「漢典舊事，丞相所請，靡有不聽。

translations.literal: At the time the Three Excellencies' duties were light and crucial affairs were entrusted solely to the Secretariat; yet when disasters and strange omens occurred, the Three Excellencies were abruptly dismissed. Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying: "By Han precedent and old practice, what the Chancellor requested was never not heard."
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Three Excellencies' duties were light and crucial affairs were entrusted solely to the Secretariat; yet when disasters and strange omens occurred, the Three Excellencies were abruptly dismissed. Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying, "By Han precedent and old practice, what the Chancellor requested was never not heard."

sentences.zh: 今之三公，雖當其名而無其實，選舉誅賞，一由尚書，尚書見任，重於三公，陵遲以來，其漸久矣。

translations.literal: " Today's Three Excellencies, though bearing the name, lack the substance. Selection, punishment, and reward all depend on the Secretariat. The Secretariat in present trust weighs more than the Three Excellencies. Since decline began, this has long been gradual."
translations.idiomatic: " Today's Three Excellencies, though bearing the name, lack the substance. Selection, punishment, and reward all depend on the Secretariat. The Secretariat in present trust weighs more than the Three Excellencies. Since decline began, this has long been gradual."

sentences.zh: 臣忠心常獨不安。

translations.literal: " Your servant's loyal heart is constantly ill at ease alone."
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant's loyal heart is constantly ill at ease alone."

sentences.zh: 近以地震，策免司空陳褒，今者災異，復欲切讓三公。

translations.literal: " Recently, because of an earthquake, Minister of Works Chen Bao was dismissed by imperial rescript. Now with calamities and anomalies, you again wish sharply to reprove the Three Excellencies."
translations.idiomatic: " Recently, because of an earthquake, Minister of Works Chen Bao was dismissed by imperial rescript. Now with calamities and anomalies, you again wish sharply to reprove the Three Excellencies."

sentences.zh: 昔孝成皇帝以妖星守心，移咎丞相，卒不蒙上天之福，徒乖宋景之誠。

translations.literal: " Formerly Emperor Xiaocheng, because a demon star guarded the Heart, shifted blame to the Chancellor and in the end did not receive heaven's blessing, vainly betraying Song Jing's sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: " Formerly Emperor Xiaocheng, because a demon star guarded the Heart, shifted blame to the Chancellor and in the end did not receive heaven's blessing, vainly betraying Song Jing's sincerity."

sentences.zh: 故知是非之分，較然有歸矣。

translations.literal: " Thus one knows that the division of right and wrong is comparatively clear and has its proper place."
translations.idiomatic: " Thus one knows that the division of right and wrong is comparatively clear and has its proper place."

sentences.zh: 又尚書決事，多違故典，罪法無例，詆欺為先，文慘言丑，有乖章憲。

translations.literal: " Moreover the Secretariat decides cases, often violating old statutes; penal law lacks precedent and slander and fraud come first—texts cruel and words ugly, at odds with the fundamental laws."
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover the Secretariat decides cases, often violating old statutes. Penal law lacks precedent and slander and fraud come first—texts cruel and words ugly, at odds with the fundamental laws."

sentences.zh: 宜責求其意，割而勿聽，上順國典，下防威福，置方員於規矩，審輕重於衡石，誠國家之典，萬世之法也！

translations.literal: " It is fitting to demand their intent, cut them off and do not hear them—above to follow state statutes, below to guard against authority and favor, set square and round within compass and rule, examine light and heavy on the balance stone—truly the state's canon and the law for ten thousand generations!"
translations.idiomatic: " It is fitting to demand their intent, cut them off and do not hear them—above to follow state statutes, below to guard against authority and favor, set square and round within compass and rule, examine light and heavy on the balance stone—truly the state's canon and the law for ten thousand generations!"

sentences.zh: 汝南太守山陽王龔，政崇溫和，好才愛士。

translations.literal: Administrator of Runan Wang Gong of Shanyang made his government honor warmth and harmony and loved talent and cherished scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Runan Wang Gong of Shanyang made his government honor warmth and harmony and loved talent and cherished scholars.

sentences.zh: 以袁閬為功曹，引進郡人黃憲、陳蕃等；

translations.literal: He made Yuan Lang Merit Officer and introduced fellow commandery men Huang Xian, Chen Fan, and others;
translations.idiomatic: He made Yuan Lang Merit Officer and introduced fellow commandery men Huang Xian, Chen Fan, and others;

sentences.zh: 憲雖不屈，蕃遂就吏。

translations.literal: Xian though did not submit, Fan thereupon took office.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Xian though did not submit, Chen Fan thereupon took office.

sentences.zh: 閬不修異操而致名當時，蕃性氣高明，龔皆禮之，由是群士莫不歸心。

translations.literal: Lang did not cultivate unusual conduct yet achieved fame in his time; Fan's nature and spirit were lofty and bright. Gong honored them all, and thereby the mass of scholars none failed to give their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Lang did not cultivate unusual conduct yet achieved fame in his time; Chen Fan's nature and spirit were lofty and bright. Wang Gong honored them all, and thereby the mass of scholars none failed to give their hearts.

sentences.zh: 憲世貧賤，父為牛醫。

translations.literal: Xian's family for generations was poor and lowly; his father was a cattle doctor.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Xian's family for generations was poor and lowly; his father was a cattle doctor.

sentences.zh: 穎川荀淑至慎陽，遇憲於逆旅，時年十四；

translations.literal: Xun Shu of Yingchuan reached Shenyang and met Xian at a roadside inn when he was fourteen;
translations.idiomatic: Xun Shu of Yingchuan reached Shenyang and met Huang Xian at a roadside inn when he was fourteen;

sentences.zh: 淑辣然異之，揖與語，移日不能去，謂憲曰：「子，吾之師表也。

translations.literal: Shu was startled and regarded him as extraordinary, bowed and conversed with him, and could not leave for a whole day, saying to Xian: "You are my model teacher."
translations.idiomatic: Xun Shu was startled and regarded him as extraordinary, bowed and conversed with him, and could not leave for a whole day, saying to Huang Xian, "You are my model teacher."

sentences.zh: 」既而前至袁閬所，未及勞問，逆曰：「子國有顏子，寧識之乎？

translations.literal: " Then he went on ahead to Yuan Lang's place and, before greetings of courtesy, said directly: "Your state has a Yan Hui—do you perhaps know him?"
translations.idiomatic: " Then he went on ahead to Yuan Lang's place and, before greetings of courtesy, said directly, "Your state has a Yan Hui—do you perhaps know him?"

sentences.zh: 」閬曰：「見吾叔度邪？

translations.literal: " Lang said: "Have you seen my Shudu?"
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan Lang said, "Have you seen my Shudu?"

sentences.zh: 」是時同郡戴良，才高倨傲，而見憲未嘗不正容，及歸，惘然若有失也。

translations.literal: " At the time Dai Liang of the same commandery was talented, lofty, and proud, yet when he saw Xian he never failed to straighten his countenance. When he returned he was dazed as if he had lost something.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time Dai Liang of the same commandery was talented, lofty, and proud, yet when he saw Huang Xian he never failed to straighten his countenance. When he returned he was dazed as if he had lost something.

sentences.zh: 其母問曰：「汝復從牛醫兒來邪？

translations.literal: His mother asked: "Have you again come from the cattle doctor's son?"
translations.idiomatic: His mother asked, "Have you again come from the cattle doctor's son?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「良不見叔度，自以為無不及；

translations.literal: " He replied: "Had Liang not seen Shudu, he would have thought himself without inferior;"
translations.idiomatic: " He replied, "Had Liang not seen Shudu, he would have thought himself without inferior;"

sentences.zh: 既睹其人，則瞻之在前，忽焉在後，固難得而測矣。

translations.literal: " having seen the man, one looks and he is ahead, then suddenly he is behind—truly hard to measure."
translations.idiomatic: " having seen the man, one looks and he is ahead, then suddenly he is behind—truly hard to measure."

sentences.zh: 」陳蕃及同郡周舉常相謂曰：「時月之間不見黃生，則鄙吝之萌復存乎心矣。

translations.literal: " Chen Fan and Zhou Ju of the same commandery often said to each other: "If in the space of months one does not see Master Huang, the sprouts of meanness and stinginess return to lodge in the heart."
translations.idiomatic: " Chen Fan and Zhou Ju of the same commandery often said to each other, "If in the space of months one does not see Master Huang, the sprouts of meanness and stinginess return to lodge in the heart."

sentences.zh: 」太原郭泰，少游汝南，先過袁閬，不宿而退；

translations.literal: " Guo Tai of Taiyuan in his youth traveled in Runan, first passed Yuan Lang's place, did not lodge and withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: " Guo Tai of Taiyuan in his youth traveled in Runan, first passed Yuan Lang's place, did not lodge and withdrew;

sentences.zh: 進，往從憲，累日方還。

translations.literal: advanced and went to follow Xian, and only after many days returned.
translations.idiomatic: advanced and went to follow Huang Xian, and only after many days returned.

sentences.zh: 或以問泰，曰：「奉高之器，譬諸氿濫，雖清而易挹。

translations.literal: Someone questioned Tai, who said: "Fenggao's vessel is like a shallow pool—though clear, it is easy to dip from."
translations.idiomatic: Someone questioned Guo Tai, who said, "Fenggao's vessel is like a shallow pool—though clear, it is easy to dip from."

sentences.zh: 叔度汪汪若千頃陂，澄之不清，淆之不濁，不可量也。

translations.literal: " Shudu's vastness is like a thousand-qing pond—clarify it and it is not clear, stir it and it is not turbid; it cannot be measured."
translations.idiomatic: " Shudu's vastness is like a thousand-qing pond—clarify it and it is not clear, stir it and it is not turbid; it cannot be measured."

sentences.zh: 」憲初舉孝廉，又辟公府。

translations.literal: " Xian was first recommended as Filial and Incorrupt and also summoned to the public offices."
translations.idiomatic: " Huang Xian was first recommended as Filial and Incorrupt and also summoned to the public offices."

sentences.zh: 友人勸其仕，憲亦不拒之，暫到京師，即還，竟無所就，年四十八終。

translations.literal: Friends urged him to take office; Xian also did not refuse them, briefly reached the capital and at once returned, and in the end achieved nothing—he died at forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Friends urged him to take office. Huang Xian also did not refuse them, briefly reached the capital and at once returned, and in the end achieved nothing—he died at forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 范曄論曰：黃憲言論風旨，無所傳聞；

translations.literal: Fan Ye's commentary says: Huang Xian's discourses and style and intent have nothing transmitted;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ye's commentary says: Huang Xian's discourses and style and intent have nothing transmitted;

sentences.zh: 然士君子見之者，靡不服深遠，去玭吝，將以道周性全，無德而稱乎！

translations.literal: yet when gentlemen saw him, none failed to submit to his depth and distance, cast off blemish and stinginess, and would use the Way to complete nature and achieve fullness—can this be called having virtue without display!
translations.idiomatic: yet when gentlemen saw him, none failed to submit to his depth and distance, cast off blemish and stinginess, and would use the Way to complete nature and achieve fullness—can this be called having virtue without display!

sentences.zh: 余曾祖穆侯以為：「憲，隤然其處順，淵乎其似道，淺深莫臻其分，清濁未議其方，若及門於孔氏，其殆庶乎！

translations.literal: My great-grandfather Marquis Mu held: "Xian—humble in dwelling in compliance, deep as if resembling the Way; shallow and deep cannot reach his measure, clear and turbid cannot debate his direction. If he had entered Confucius's gate, he would nearly have been close!"
translations.idiomatic: My great-grandfather Marquis Mu held, "Huang Xian—humble in dwelling in compliance, deep as if resembling the Way; shallow and deep cannot reach his measure, clear and turbid cannot debate his direction. If he had entered Confucius's gate, he would nearly have been close!"

sentences.zh: 春，正月，旄牛夷反，益州刺史張喬擊破之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, the Maoniu Yi rebelled; Governor of Yizhou Zhang Qiao attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, the Maoniu Yi rebelled. Governor of Yizhou Zhang Qiao attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，戊子，爵乳母王聖為野王君。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on wuzi, the wet nurse Wang Sheng was ennobled as Lady of Yewang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on wuzi day, the wet nurse Wang Sheng was ennobled as Lady of Yewang.

sentences.zh: 北匈奴連與車師入寇河西，議者欲復閉玉門、陽關以絕其患。

translations.literal: The Northern Xiongnu repeatedly joined Cheshi in raiding Hexi; deliberators wished again to close Yumenguan and Yangguan to cut off the trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Xiongnu repeatedly joined Cheshi in raiding Hexi. Deliberators wished again to close Yumenguan and Yangguan to cut off the trouble.

sentences.zh: 敦煌太守張璫上書曰：「臣在京師，亦以為西域宜棄，今親踐其土地，乃知棄西域則河西不能自存。

translations.literal: Administrator of Dunhuang Zhang Heng submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant in the capital also thought the Western Regions ought to be abandoned. Now having personally trodden their lands, I know that abandoning the Western Regions means Hexi cannot preserve itself."
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Dunhuang Zhang Heng submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant in the capital also thought the Western Regions ought to be abandoned. Now having personally trodden their lands, I know that abandoning the Western Regions means Hexi cannot preserve itself."

sentences.zh: 謹陳西域三策：北虜呼衍王常展轉蒲類、秦海之間，專制西域，共為寇鈔。

translations.literal: " I respectfully set forth three plans for the Western Regions: the Northern barbarians' King Huyan of the Hu often ranged between Pulei and Qinhai, monopolizing the Western Regions and together raiding and plundering."
translations.idiomatic: " I respectfully set forth three plans for the Western Regions: the Northern barbarians' King Huyan of the Hu often ranged between Pulei and Qinhai, monopolizing the Western Regions and together raiding and plundering."

sentences.zh: 今以酒泉屬國吏士二千餘人集崑崙塞，先擊呼衍王，絕其根本，因發鄯善兵五千人脅車師後部，此上計也。

translations.literal: " Now with more than two thousand officials and soldiers of the Dependent State of Jiuquan assemble at Kunlun Pass, first strike King Huyan and cut his root, then send five thousand Shanshan troops to threaten the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi—this is the upper plan."
translations.idiomatic: " Now with more than two thousand officials and soldiers of the Dependent State of Jiuquan assemble at Kunlun Pass, first strike King Huyan and cut his root, then send five thousand Shanshan troops to threaten the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi—this is the upper plan."

sentences.zh: 若不能出兵，可置軍司馬，將士五百人，四郡供其犁牛、谷食，出據柳中，此中計也。

translations.literal: " If troops cannot be sent out, one may station an army Major with five hundred officers and soldiers; the four commanderies supply their plow oxen and grain food, and go out to hold Liuzhong—this is the middle plan."
translations.idiomatic: " If troops cannot be sent out, one may station an army Major with five hundred officers and soldiers. The four commanderies supply their plow oxen and grain food, and go out to hold Liuzhong—this is the middle plan."

sentences.zh: 如又不能，則宜棄交河城，收鄯善等悉使入塞，此下計也。

translations.literal: " If again this cannot be done, then one ought to abandon Jiaohe city, gather Shanshan and the rest and all make them enter the passes—this is the lower plan."
translations.idiomatic: " If again this cannot be done, then one ought to abandon Jiaohe city, gather Shanshan and the rest and all make them enter the passes—this is the lower plan."

sentences.zh: 」朝廷下其議。

translations.literal: " The court transmitted his proposal for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The court transmitted his proposal for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 陳忠上疏曰：「西域內附日久，區區東望扣關者數矣，此其不樂匈奴、慕漢之效也。

translations.literal: Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying: "The Western Regions have long been inwardly attached; for a long time they have looked east and knocked at the passes—this is the effect of their disliking the Xiongnu and admiring Han."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhong submitted a memorial, saying, "The Western Regions have long been inwardly attached. For a long time they have looked east and knocked at the passes—this is the effect of their disliking the Xiongnu and admiring Han."

sentences.zh: 今北虜已破車師，勢必南攻鄯善，棄而不救，則諸國從矣。

translations.literal: " Now the Northern barbarians have already defeated Cheshi and will surely attack Shanshan southward. If abandoned and not rescued, then the various states will follow."
translations.idiomatic: " Now the Northern barbarians have already defeated Cheshi and will surely attack Shanshan southward. If abandoned and not rescued, then the various states will follow."

sentences.zh: 若然，則虜財賄益增，膽勢益殖，威臨南羌，與之交通，如此，河西四郡危矣。

translations.literal: " If so, the barbarians' wealth and bribes increase ever more, their courage and momentum breed ever more, their authority presses on the Southern Qiang and they join in communication—with this the four Hexi commanderies are in peril."
translations.idiomatic: " If so, the barbarians' wealth and bribes increase ever more, their courage and momentum breed ever more, their authority presses on the Southern Qiang and they join in communication—with this the four Hexi commanderies are in peril."

sentences.zh: 河西既危，不可不救，則百倍之役興，不訾之費發矣。

translations.literal: " Once Hexi is in peril it cannot but be rescued, and then labor a hundredfold arises and expense beyond reckoning is unleashed."
translations.idiomatic: " Once Hexi is in peril it cannot but be rescued, and then labor a hundredfold arises and expense beyond reckoning is unleashed."

sentences.zh: 議者但念西域絕遠，恤之煩費，不見孝武苦心勤勞之意也。

translations.literal: " Deliberators only think of the Western Regions as utterly remote and pity the trouble and expense—they do not see Emperor Xiaowu's intent of bitter toil and diligent labor."
translations.idiomatic: " Deliberators only think of the Western Regions as utterly remote and pity the trouble and expense—they do not see Emperor Xiaowu's intent of bitter toil and diligent labor."

sentences.zh: 方今敦煌孤危，遠來告急；

translations.literal: " Just now Dunhuang is isolated and perilous, coming from afar to report urgency;
translations.idiomatic: " Just now Dunhuang is isolated and perilous, coming from afar to report urgency;

sentences.zh: 復不輔助，內無以慰勞吏民，外無以威示百蠻，蹙國減土，非良計也。

translations.literal: if again not aided, within there is no means to comfort officials and people, without no means to display authority to the hundred barbarians—cramped state and reduced territory is not a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: if again not aided, within there is no means to comfort officials and people, without no means to display authority to the hundred barbarians—cramped state and reduced territory is not a good plan.

sentences.zh: 臣以為敦煌宜置校尉，按舊增四郡屯兵，以西撫諸國。

translations.literal: " Your servant thinks Dunhuang ought to have a colonel stationed, and according to old practice increase garrison troops of the four commanderies to pacify the various states from the west."
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant thinks Dunhuang ought to have a colonel stationed, and according to old practice increase garrison troops of the four commanderies to pacify the various states from the west."

sentences.zh: 」帝納之，於是復以班勇為西域長史，將兵五百人出屯柳中。

translations.literal: " The emperor accepted it, and thereupon again made Ban Yong Chief Clerk of the Western Regions, leading five hundred troops to go out and encamp at Liuzhong.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted it, and thereupon again made Ban Yong Chief Clerk of the Western Regions, leading five hundred troops to go out and encamp at Liuzhong.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，丹楊山崩。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Mount Danyang collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Mount Danyang collapsed.

sentences.zh: 九月，郡國五雨水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, five commanderies and states suffered rain floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, five commanderies and states suffered rain floods.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，辛未，太尉劉愷罷；

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinwei, Grand Commandant Liu Kai was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, Grand Commandant Liu Kai was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以司徒楊震為太尉，光祿勳東萊劉熹為司徒。

translations.literal: on jiaxu, made Minister over the Masses Yang Zhen Grand Commandant and Household Minister Liu Xi of Donglai Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: on jiaxu day, Minister over the Masses Yang Zhen was made Grand Commandant and Household Minister Liu Xi of Donglai was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 大鴻臚耿寶自候震，薦中常侍李閏兄於震曰：「李常侍國家所重，欲令公辟其兄；

translations.literal: Grand Herald Geng Bao personally called on Zhen and recommended to Zhen the younger brother of Regular Attendant Li Run, saying: "Regular Attendant Li is weighty in the state; he wishes to have your lordship summon his brother;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Herald Geng Bao personally called on Yang Zhen and recommended to Yang Zhen the younger brother of Regular Attendant Li Run, saying, "Regular Attendant Li is weighty in the state. He wishes to have your lordship summon his brother;

sentences.zh: 寶唯傳上意耳。

translations.literal: Bao only transmits the superior's intent."
translations.idiomatic: Geng Bao only transmits the superior's intent."

sentences.zh: 」震曰：「如朝廷欲令三府辟召，故宜有尚書敕。

translations.literal: " Zhen said: "If the court wishes the Three Excellencies to summon and appoint, there ought properly to be a Secretariat edict."
translations.idiomatic: " Yang Zhen said, "If the court wishes the Three Excellencies to summon and appoint, there ought properly to be a Secretariat edict."

sentences.zh: 」寶大恨而去。

translations.literal: " Bao left in great resentment.
translations.idiomatic: " Geng Bao left in great resentment.

sentences.zh: 執金吾閻顯亦薦所親於震，震又不從。

translations.literal: Commandant of Justice Yan Xian also recommended his intimate to Zhen; Zhen again did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of Justice Yan Xian also recommended his intimate to Yang Zhen; Yang Zhen again did not comply.

sentences.zh: 司空劉授聞之，即辟此二人；

translations.literal: Minister of Works Liu Shou heard of it and at once summoned these two men;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Liu Shou heard of it and at once summoned these two men;

sentences.zh: 由是震益見怨。

translations.literal: thereby Zhen was ever more resented.
translations.idiomatic: thereby Yang Zhen was ever more resented.

sentences.zh: 時詔遣使者大為王聖修第；

translations.literal: At the time an edict sent envoys to build Lady Wang Sheng's residence on a great scale;
translations.idiomatic: At the time an edict sent envoys to build Lady Wang Sheng's residence on a great scale;

sentences.zh: 中常侍樊豐及侍中周廣、謝惲等更相扇動，傾搖朝廷。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant Fan Feng and Palace Attendants Zhou Guang, Xie Yun, and others stirred one another on and rocked the court.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant Fan Feng and Palace Attendants Zhou Guang, Xie Yun, and others stirred one another on and rocked the court.

sentences.zh: 震上疏曰：「臣伏念方今災害滋甚，百姓空虛，三邊震擾，帑藏匱乏，殆非社稷安寧之時。

translations.literal: Zhen submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant reflects that just now disasters grow ever worse, the people are empty and depleted, the three frontiers are shaken and disturbed, and the treasury is exhausted and lacking—hardly a time for the altars of state to be at peace."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant reflects that just now disasters grow ever worse, the people are empty and depleted, the three frontiers are shaken and disturbed, and the treasury is exhausted and lacking—hardly a time for the altars of state to be at peace."

sentences.zh: 詔書為阿母興起第捨，合兩為一，連裡竟街，雕修繕飾，窮極巧伎，攻山採石，轉相迫促，為費巨億。

translations.literal: " An edict builds residences for the foster mother, joining two into one, linking lanes through whole streets, carved ornament and repair and decoration exhausting ingenious craft, attacking mountains and quarrying stone, pressing one another in relays—expense reaches hundreds of millions."
translations.idiomatic: " An edict builds residences for the foster mother, joining two into one, linking lanes through whole streets, carved ornament and repair and decoration exhausting ingenious craft, attacking mountains and quarrying stone, pressing one another in relays—expense reaches hundreds of millions."

sentences.zh: 周廣、謝惲兄弟，與國無肺府枝葉之屬，依倚近幸奸佞之人，與之分威共權，屬托州郡，傾動大臣。

translations.literal: " The brothers Zhou Guang and Xie Yun have with the state no bond of lung and viscera or branch and leaf. They rely on those near and favored, treacherous and flattering men, share authority and power with them, entrust affairs to commanderies and prefectures, and shake great ministers."
translations.idiomatic: " The brothers Zhou Guang and Xie Yun have with the state no bond of lung and viscera or branch and leaf. They rely on those near and favored, treacherous and flattering men, share authority and power with them, entrust affairs to commanderies and prefectures, and shake great ministers."

sentences.zh: 宰司辟召，承望旨意，招來海內貪污之人，受其貨賂，至有臧錮棄世之徒，復得顯用；

translations.literal: " Chief ministers summon and appoint, looking to their intent; they draw in the empire's corrupt men, receive their bribes—even those imprisoned and discarded from the world again obtain prominent employment;
translations.idiomatic: " Chief ministers summon and appoint, looking to their intent. They draw in the empire's corrupt men and receive their bribes—even those imprisoned and discarded from the world again obtain prominent employment;

sentences.zh: 白黑混淆，清濁同源，天下讙嘩，為朝結譏。

translations.literal: white and black are confused, clear and turbid share one source—all under heaven clamors and knots ridicule for the court.
translations.idiomatic: white and black are confused, clear and turbid share one source—all under heaven clamors and knots ridicule for the court.

sentences.zh: 臣聞師言，上之所取，財盡則怨，力盡則叛，怨叛之人，不可復使，惟陛下度之！

translations.literal: " Your servant has heard the master's words: what the superior takes—when wealth is exhausted there is resentment, when strength is exhausted there is rebellion. Men resentful and rebellious cannot again be employed. Only Your Majesty measure this!"
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant has heard the master's words: what the superior takes—when wealth is exhausted there is resentment, when strength is exhausted there is rebellion. Men resentful and rebellious cannot again be employed. Only Your Majesty measure this!"

sentences.zh: 」上不聽。

translations.literal: " The emperor did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor did not listen.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑其至鞬自將萬餘騎攻南匈奴於曼柏，薁鞬日逐王戰死，殺千餘人。

translations.literal: The Xianbei chanyu Qizhi personally led more than ten thousand horsemen to attack the Southern Xiongnu at Manbai. The Yuwu Rizhu King died in battle and more than a thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei chanyu Qizhi personally led more than ten thousand horsemen to attack the Southern Xiongnu at Manbai. The Yuwu Rizhu King died in battle and more than a thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，戊辰，京師及郡國三地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the capital and three commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen day, the capital and three commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 陳忠薦汝南周燮、南陽馮良學行深純，隱居不仕，名重於世；

translations.literal: Chen Zhong recommended Zhou Xie of Runan and Feng Liang of Nanyang as deep and pure in learning and conduct, dwelling in seclusion without taking office, their fame weighty in the world;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhong recommended Zhou Xie of Runan and Feng Liang of Nanyang as deep and pure in learning and conduct, dwelling in seclusion without taking office, their fame weighty in the world;

sentences.zh: 帝以玄纁羔幣聘之；

translations.literal: the emperor employed dark silk and lamb offerings to engage them;
translations.idiomatic: the emperor employed dark silk and lamb offerings to engage them;

sentences.zh: 燮宗族更勸之曰：「夫修德立行，所以為國，君獨何為守東岡之陂乎？

translations.literal: Xie's clan elders again urged him, saying: "To cultivate virtue and establish conduct is to serve the state—why alone do you, sir, keep to the slope of the eastern mound?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xie's clan elders again urged him, saying, "To cultivate virtue and establish conduct is to serve the state—why alone do you, sir, keep to the slope of the eastern mound?"

sentences.zh: 」燮曰：「夫修道者度其時而動，動而不時，焉得亨乎！

translations.literal: " Xie said: "One who cultivates the Way measures the time and then acts. To act without timeliness—how can one attain success!"
translations.idiomatic: " Zhou Xie said, "One who cultivates the Way measures the time and then acts. To act without timeliness—how can one attain success!"

sentences.zh: 」與良皆自載至近縣，稱病而還。

translations.literal: " He and Liang both drove themselves to a nearby county, claimed illness, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: " He and Feng Liang both drove themselves to a nearby county, claimed illness, and returned.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，班勇至樓蘭，以鄯善歸附，特加三綬，而龜茲王白英猶自疑未下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Ban Yong reached Loulan. Because Shanshan submitted, he was specially given triple ribbons, yet King Bai Ying of Kucha still doubted and had not submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, Ban Yong reached Loulan. Because Shanshan submitted, he was specially given triple ribbons, yet King Bai Ying of Kucha still doubted and had not submitted.

sentences.zh: 勇開以恩信，白英乃率姑墨、溫宿，自縛詣勇，因發其兵步騎萬餘人到車師前王庭，擊走匈奴伊蠡王於伊和谷，收得前部五千餘人，於是前部始復開通。

translations.literal: Yong opened them with grace and trust; Bai Ying thereupon led Gumo and Wensu, bound himself and came to Yong, and thereby sent out his troops, infantry and cavalry more than ten thousand, to the Former King's court of Cheshi. They struck and drove off the Xiongnu Yili King at Yihe Valley, gathered more than five thousand of the Front Division, and thereby the Front Division for the first time was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Yong opened them with grace and trust. Bai Ying thereupon led Gumo and Wensu, bound himself and came to Yong, and thereby sent out his troops, infantry and cavalry more than ten thousand, to the Former King's court of Cheshi. They struck and drove off the Xiongnu Yili King at Yihe Valley, gathered more than five thousand of the Front Division, and thereby the Front Division for the first time was reopened.

sentences.zh: 還，屯田柳中。

translations.literal: He returned and farmed garrison fields at Liuzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He returned and farmed garrison fields at Liuzhong.

sentences.zh: 二月，丙子，車駕東巡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingzi, the imperial carriage toured east.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingzi day, the imperial carriage toured east.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸泰山。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he visited Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, he visited Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 三月，戊戌，幸魯，還，幸東平，至東郡，歷魏郡、河內而還。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuxu, he visited Lu, returned, visited Dongping, reached Dong Commandery, passed through Weijun and Hanoi, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day, he visited Lu, returned, visited Dongping, reached Dong Commandery, passed through Weijun and Hanoi, and returned.

sentences.zh: 初，樊豐、周廣、謝惲等見楊震連諫不從，無所顧忌，遂詐作詔書，調發司農錢穀、大匠見徒材木，各起家捨、園池、廬觀，役費無數。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Fan Feng, Zhou Guang, Xie Yun, and others saw Yang Zhen's repeated remonstrances not followed, they had no regard left and thereupon forged edicts, requisitioning Grand Minister of Agriculture money and grain and the Grand Artisan's present corvée timber, each building residences, gardens and ponds, and towers and galleries—labor expense beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Fan Feng, Zhou Guang, Xie Yun, and others saw Yang Zhen's repeated remonstrances not followed, they had no regard left and thereupon forged edicts, requisitioning Grand Minister of Agriculture money and grain and the Grand Artisan's present corvée timber, each building residences, gardens and ponds, and towers and galleries—labor expense beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 震復上疏曰：「臣備台輔，不能調和陰陽，去年十二月四日，京師地動，其日戊辰；

translations.literal: Zhen again submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant fills the terrace and assists, yet cannot harmonize yin and yang. Last year on the fourth day of the twelfth month the capital shook—the day was wuchen;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen again submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant fills the terrace and assists, yet cannot harmonize yin and yang. Last year on the fourth day of the twelfth month the capital shook—the day was wuchen;

sentences.zh: 三者皆土，位在中宮，此中臣、近官持權用事之象也。

translations.literal: " all three are earth, positioned in the central palace—this is the image of inner ministers and near officials holding power and managing affairs."
translations.idiomatic: " all three are earth, positioned in the central palace—this is the image of inner ministers and near officials holding power and managing affairs."

sentences.zh: 臣伏惟陛下以邊境未寧，躬身菲薄，宮殿垣屋傾倚，枝拄而已。

translations.literal: " Your servant reflects that Your Majesty, because the borders are not yet peaceful, personally practices frugality—palace walls and roofs lean and are propped with branches only."
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant reflects that Your Majesty, because the borders are not yet peaceful, personally practices frugality—palace walls and roofs lean and are propped with branches only."

sentences.zh: 而親近幸臣，未崇斷金，驕溢逾法，多請徒士，盛修第捨，賣弄威福，道路讙嘩，地動之變，殆為此發。

translations.literal: Yet he draws close to favored ministers, does not honor severing metal, arrogance overflows beyond law, repeatedly requests convict laborers, lavishly builds mansions, trades on and displays authority and favor, the roads clamor, and the earth-quake prodigy was probably triggered by this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he draws close to favored ministers, does not honor unbreakable loyalty, lets arrogance overflow beyond the law, repeatedly requests convict laborers, lavishly builds mansions, and trades on authority and favor until the roads clamor—the earth-quake prodigy was probably triggered by this.

sentences.zh: 又，冬無宿雪，春節未雨，百僚焦心，而繕修不止，誠致旱之征也。

translations.literal: Moreover, winter had no lasting snow, the spring festivals passed without rain, the hundred officials were anxious, yet repairs did not cease—truly a sign that drought would come.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, winter had no lasting snow and the spring festivals passed without rain. The hundred officials were anxious, yet repairs did not cease—truly a sign that drought would come.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下奮乾剛之德，棄驕奢之臣，以承皇天之戒！

translations.literal: May Your Majesty alone exert the virtue of Qian's firmness, discard arrogant and extravagant ministers, and receive the August Heaven's warning!
translations.idiomatic: May Your Majesty exert the firm virtue of Qian, discard arrogant and extravagant ministers, and heed Heaven's warning!

sentences.zh: 」震前後所言轉切，帝既不平之，而樊豐等皆側目憤怨，以其名儒，未敢加害。

translations.literal: Zhen's successive memorials grew ever sharper; the Emperor was already displeased, while Fan Feng and others glared with anger and resentment, yet because he was a renowned scholar they did not dare harm him.
