translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen's successive memorials grew ever sharper. The Emperor was already displeased, while Fan Feng and others glared with anger and resentment, yet because he was a renowned scholar they did not dare harm him.

sentences.zh: 會河間男子趙騰上書指陳得失，帝發怒，遂收考詔獄，結以罔上不道。

translations.literal: It happened that Zhao Teng, a commoner of Hejian, submitted a memorial pointing out gains and losses; the Emperor flew into rage and had him arrested and examined in the imperial prison, the charge being deception of superiors and impiety.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Zhao Teng, a commoner of Hejian, submitted a memorial pointing out gains and losses. The Emperor flew into a rage, had him arrested and examined in the imperial prison, and charged him with deceiving his superiors and impiety.

sentences.zh: 震上疏救之曰：「臣聞殷、周哲王，小人怨詈，則還自敬德。

translations.literal: Zhen memorialized to save him, saying: "Your servant has heard that the wise kings of Yin and Zhou, when petty men cursed in resentment, would turn back and examine their own virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Zhen memorialized to save him, saying, "Your servant has heard that the wise kings of Yin and Zhou, when petty men cursed in resentment, would turn back and examine their own virtue."

sentences.zh: 今趙騰所坐，激訐謗語，為罪與手刃犯法有差，乞為虧除，全騰之命，以誘芻蕘輿論人之言。

translations.literal: Now Zhao Teng's offense was provocative slanderous words; as a crime it differs from personally wielding a blade to break the law. I beg that it be mitigated and Teng's life spared, to encourage the speech of common men bearing firewood on their backs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Teng's offense was provocative slander, a crime that differs from personally wielding a blade to break the law. I beg that it be mitigated and Teng's life spared, to encourage speech from common men in the streets.

sentences.zh: 」帝不聽，騰竟伏屍都市。

translations.literal: The Emperor would not listen; Teng in the end was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor would not listen. Teng was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 及帝東巡，樊豐等因乘輿在外，競修第宅，太尉部掾高舒召大匠令史考校之，得豐等所詐下詔書，具奏，須行還上之，豐等惶怖。

translations.literal: When the Emperor made an eastern tour, Fan Feng and others, because the imperial carriage was abroad, competed in building mansions. Gao Shu, a clerk of the Grand Commandant's office, summoned the chief craftsman clerks to examine them and obtained the forged edicts Fan Feng and others had used; he memorialized fully and was to present it when the procession returned—Fan Feng and others were terrified.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor made an eastern tour, Fan Feng and others, with the imperial carriage abroad, competed in building mansions. Gao Shu, a clerk of the Grand Commandant's office, summoned the chief craftsman clerks to examine them and obtained the forged edicts Fan Feng and others had used. He memorialized fully and was to present it when the procession returned. Fan Feng and others were terrified.

sentences.zh: 會太史言星變逆行，遂共譖震云：「自趙騰死後，深用怨懟；

translations.literal: It happened that the Grand Astrologer reported stars changing and moving retrograde; they then jointly slandered Zhen, saying: "Since Zhao Teng's death he has deeply harbored resentment;"
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Grand Astrologer reported stars changing and moving retrograde. They then jointly slandered Zhen, saying, "Since Zhao Teng's death he has deeply harbored resentment;"

sentences.zh: 且鄧氏故吏，有恚恨之心。

translations.literal: moreover, as a former subordinate of the Deng clan, he bears a resentful heart."
translations.idiomatic: moreover, as a former subordinate of the Deng clan, he bears a resentful heart."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，車駕還京師，便時太學，夜，遺使者策收震太尉印綬；

translations.literal: On renxu day the imperial carriage returned to the capital, stopping by the Imperial Academy; that night emissaries were sent with a written order to take back Zhen's Grand Commandant seal and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial carriage returned to the capital, stopping by the Imperial Academy. That night emissaries were sent with a written order to take back Zhen's Grand Commandant seal and ribbon.

sentences.zh: 震於是柴門絕賓客。

translations.literal: Zhen thereupon barred his wicket gate and cut off visitors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen thereupon barred his wicket gate and cut off visitors.

sentences.zh: 豐等復惡之，令大鴻臚耿寶奏：「震大臣，不服罪，懷恚望。

translations.literal: Fan Feng and others again hated him and had Minister Herald Geng Bao memorialize: "Zhen is a great minister who will not acknowledge guilt and harbors resentment."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Feng and others again hated him and had Minister Herald Geng Bao memorialize, "Zhen is a great minister who will not acknowledge guilt and harbors resentment."

sentences.zh: 」有詔，遣歸本郡。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him sent back to his native commandery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him sent back to his native commandery.

sentences.zh: 震行至城西幾陽亭，乃慷慨謂其諸子、門人曰：「死者，士之常分。

translations.literal: When Zhen reached Jiyang pavilion west of the city he spoke passionately to his sons and disciples: "Death is the constant lot of a gentleman."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen reached Jiyang pavilion west of the city he spoke passionately to his sons and disciples, "Death is the constant lot of a gentleman."

sentences.zh: 吾蒙恩居上司，疾奸臣狡猾而不能誅，惡嬖女傾亂而不能禁，何面目復見日月！

translations.literal: I received grace and held high office, yet hated crafty treacherous ministers and could not execute them, loathed favored women who overturned order and could not restrain them—what face have I to see the sun and moon again!
translations.idiomatic: I received grace and held high office, yet hated crafty treacherous ministers and could not execute them, loathed favored women who overturned order and could not restrain them—what face have I to see the sun and moon again!

sentences.zh: 身死之日，以雜木為棺，布單被，裁足蓋形，勿歸塚次，勿設祭祀！

translations.literal: On the day I die, use miscellaneous wood for a coffin, a cloth sheet alone for a shroud, just enough to cover my form; do not return me to the family tomb, do not set up sacrifices!
translations.idiomatic: On the day I die, use miscellaneous wood for a coffin and a cloth sheet alone for a shroud, just enough to cover my form. Do not return me to the family tomb and do not set up sacrifices!

sentences.zh: 」因飲鴆而卒。

translations.literal: He thereupon drank poisoned wine and died.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon drank poisoned wine and died.

sentences.zh: 弘農太守移良承樊豐等旨，遣吏於陝縣留停震喪，露棺道側，謫震諸子代郵行書；

translations.literal: Yi Liang, Administrator of Hongnong, following Fan Feng and others' intent, sent officials to halt Zhen's funeral at Shaan county, exposing the coffin beside the road and relegating Zhen's sons to carry mail as post-runners.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Liang, Administrator of Hongnong, following Fan Feng and others' intent, sent officials to halt Zhen's funeral at Shaan county, exposing the coffin beside the road and relegating Zhen's sons to carry mail as post-runners.

sentences.zh: 道路皆為隕涕。

translations.literal: Travelers on the road all shed tears for him.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers on the road all shed tears for him.

sentences.zh: 太僕征羌侯來歷曰：「耿寶托元舅之親，榮寵過厚，不念報國恩，而傾側奸臣，傷害忠良，其天禍亦將至矣。

translations.literal: Minister of the Imperial Stud Marquis Who Pacified the Qiang Lai Li said: "Geng Bao relies on kinship as maternal uncle to the emperor; his glory and favor are excessively thick. He does not think of repaying the state's grace but leans with treacherous ministers and injures the loyal and good—Heaven's calamity will soon come upon him too."
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Imperial Stud Marquis Who Pacified the Qiang Lai Li said, "Geng Bao relies on kinship as the emperor's maternal uncle. His glory and favor are excessive. He does not think of repaying the state's grace but leans with treacherous ministers and injures the loyal and good—Heaven's calamity will soon come upon him too."

sentences.zh: 」歷，歙之曾孫也。

translations.literal: Li was the great-grandson of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Li was the great-grandson of Lai Xi.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，乙丑，車駕入宮。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yichou day, the imperial carriage entered the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on yichou day, the imperial carriage entered the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以光祿勳馮石為太尉。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, made Director of the Secretariat Feng Shi Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Director of the Secretariat Feng Shi was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 南單于檀死，弟拔立，為烏稽侯屍逐鞮單于。

translations.literal: The Southern Xiongnu chanyu Tan died; his younger brother Ba was established as Chanyu Wuji Hou Shizhu Di.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Xiongnu chanyu Tan died. His younger brother Ba was established as Chanyu Wuji Hou Shizhu Di.

sentences.zh: 時鮮卑數寇邊，度遼將軍耿夔與溫禺犢王呼尤徽將新降者連年出塞擊之，還使屯列衝要。

translations.literal: At the time the Xianbei repeatedly raided the border; General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui together with King Huyouhui of the Warm Yudou led the newly surrendered yearly beyond the passes to strike them, then on return had them encamp in array at strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Xianbei repeatedly raided the border. General Who Crosses the Liao Geng Kui together with King Huyouhui of the Warm Yudou led the newly surrendered yearly beyond the passes to strike them, then on return had them encamp at strategic points.

sentences.zh: 耿夔征發煩劇，新降者皆怨恨，大人阿族等遂反，脅呼尤徽欲與俱去。

translations.literal: Geng Kui's conscriptions were burdensome and vexatious; the newly surrendered all resented it, and the great men Azu and others then rebelled, coercing Huyouhui to go with them.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Kui's conscriptions were burdensome and vexatious. The newly surrendered all resented it, and the great men Azu and others then rebelled, coercing Huyouhui to go with them.

sentences.zh: 呼尤徽曰：「我老矣，受漢家恩，寧死，不能相隨！

translations.literal: Huyouhui said: "I am old; I have received the Han court's grace. I would rather die than follow you!"
translations.idiomatic: Huyouhui said, "I am old. I have received the Han court's grace. I would rather die than follow you!"

sentences.zh: 」眾所殺之，有救者，得免。

translations.literal: The masses wanted to kill him; someone rescued him and he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The masses wanted to kill him, but someone rescued him and he escaped.

sentences.zh: 阿族等遂將其眾亡去。

translations.literal: Azu and others then led their masses and fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Azu and others then led their followers and fled away.

sentences.zh: 中郎將馬翼與胡騎追擊，破之，斬獲殆盡。

translations.literal: Palace Gentleman Ma Yi with barbarian cavalry pursued and struck them, routed them, and beheaded and captured nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Gentleman Ma Yi with barbarian cavalry pursued and struck them, routed them, and beheaded and captured nearly all.

sentences.zh: 日南徼外蠻夷內屬。

translations.literal: Barbarians beyond the frontier of Rinan submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians beyond the frontier of Rinan submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 六月，鮮卑寇玄菟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Xianbei raided Xuantu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Xianbei raided Xuantu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，閬中山崩。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Mount Zhong in Langzhong collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Mount Zhong in Langzhong collapsed.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，辛巳，以大鴻臚耿寶為大將軍。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on xinsi day, made Minister Herald Geng Bao General-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on xinsi day, Minister Herald Geng Bao was made General-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 王聖、江京、樊豐等譖太子乳母王男、廚監邴吉等，殺之，家屬徙比景；

translations.literal: Wang Sheng, Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and others slandered the crown prince's wet-nurse Wang Nan and kitchen overseer Bing Ji and others, had them killed, and their families were exiled to Bijing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sheng, Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and others slandered the crown prince's wet-nurse Wang Nan and kitchen overseer Bing Ji and others, had them killed, and their families were exiled to Bijing;

sentences.zh: 太子思男、吉，數為歎息。

translations.literal: The crown prince missed Nan and Ji and often sighed in grief.
translations.idiomatic: the crown prince missed Nan and Ji and often sighed in grief.

sentences.zh: 京、豐懼有後害，乃與閻後妄造虛無，構讒太子及東宮官屬。

translations.literal: Jing and Feng feared future harm and thereupon with Empress Yan falsely fabricated emptiness and framed slander against the crown prince and Eastern Palace officials.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Feng feared future harm and thereupon with Empress Yan fabricated false charges and framed slander against the crown prince and Eastern Palace officials.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，召公卿以下，議廢太子。

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, summoned all from the Three Excellencies down, and deliberated on deposing the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was angry, summoned all from the Three Excellencies down, and deliberated on deposing the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 耿寶等承旨，皆以為當廢。

translations.literal: Geng Bao and others, following the intent, all held he should be deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Bao and others, following the intent, all held that he should be deposed.

sentences.zh: 太僕來歷與太常桓焉、廷尉犍為張皓議曰：「經說，年未滿十五，過惡不在其身；

translations.literal: Minister of the Imperial Stud Lai Li together with Director of Ceremonies Huan Yan and Commandant of Justice Zhang Hao of Qian debated, saying: "The classics teach that before the age of fifteen, transgressions and evils are not on one's person;"
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Imperial Stud Lai Li together with Director of Ceremonies Huan Yan and Commandant of Justice Zhang Hao of Qian argued, saying, "The classics teach that before the age of fifteen, transgressions and evils are not on one's person;"

sentences.zh: 且男、吉之謀，皇太子容有不知；

translations.literal: moreover, in Nan and Ji's scheming, the heir apparent may well have been unaware;
translations.idiomatic: moreover, in Nan and Ji's scheming, the heir apparent may well have been unaware;

sentences.zh: 宜選忠良保傅，輔以禮義。

translations.literal: one ought to select loyal and good tutors and assistants and instruct him with ritual and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: one ought to select loyal and good tutors and assistants and instruct him with ritual and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 廢置事重，此誠聖恩所宜宿留！

translations.literal: Deposing is a weighty matter—this is truly where sage grace should pause overnight!
translations.idiomatic: Deposing him is a weighty matter—this is truly where Your Majesty's grace should pause and reflect!

sentences.zh: 」帝不從。

translations.literal: The Emperor would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor would not follow.

sentences.zh: 焉，郁之子也。

translations.literal: Yan was the son of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was the son of Huan Yu.

sentences.zh: 張皓退，復上書曰：「昔賊臣江充造構讒逆，傾覆戾園，孝武久乃覺寤，雖追前失，悔之何及。

translations.literal: Zhang Hao withdrew, then memorialized again, saying: "Formerly the treacherous minister Jiang Chong fabricated slander and treason, overturning Li Garden; Emperor Wu long afterward only awakened—though he pursued the earlier fault, what use was regret?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao withdrew, then memorialized again, saying, "Formerly the treacherous minister Jiang Chong fabricated slander and treason and overturned Li Garden. Emperor Wu long afterward only awakened—though he pursued the earlier fault, what use was regret?"

sentences.zh: 今皇太子方十歲，未習保傅之教，可遽責乎！

translations.literal: Now the heir apparent is just ten years old, untrained in the tutors' teaching—can he be hastily blamed!
translations.idiomatic: Now the heir apparent is just ten years old and untrained in the tutors' teaching—can he be hastily blamed!

sentences.zh: 」書奏，不省。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; it was not considered.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor did not consider it.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁酉，廢皇太子保為濟陰王，居於德陽殿西鐘下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, Crown Prince Bao was deposed and made Prince of Jiyin, dwelling beneath the bell west of the Hall of Virtuous Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, Crown Prince Bao was deposed and made Prince of Jiyin, dwelling beneath the bell west of the Hall of Virtuous Yang.

sentences.zh: 來歷乃要結光祿勳祋諷、宗正劉瑋、將作大匠薛皓、侍中閭丘弘、陳光、趙代、施延、太中大夫九江朱倀等十餘人，俱詣鴻都門證太子無過。

translations.literal: Li thereupon joined with Director of the Secretariat Zhen Feng, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Wei, Master of Works Xue Hao, Palace Attendants Lüqiu Hong, Chen Guang, Zhao Dai, Shi Yan, Palace Counsellor Zhu Chang of Jiujiang, and more than ten others—all went together to Hongdu Gate to attest that the crown prince was without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Li thereupon joined with Director of the Secretariat Zhen Feng, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Wei, Master of Works Xue Hao, Palace Attendants Lüqiu Hong, Chen Guang, Zhao Dai, Shi Yan, Palace Counsellor Zhu Chang of Jiujiang, and more than ten others. All went together to Hongdu Gate to attest that the crown prince was without fault.

sentences.zh: 帝與左右患之，乃使中常侍奉詔脅群臣曰：「父子一體，天性自然；

translations.literal: The Emperor and his close attendants were vexed and had a palace attendant present the edict to intimidate the ministers, saying: "Father and son are one body; nature is inherent;"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor and his close attendants were vexed and had a palace attendant present the edict to intimidate the ministers, saying, "Father and son are one body; nature is inherent;"

sentences.zh: 以義割恩，為天下也。

translations.literal: cutting affection for righteousness is for all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: cutting affection for righteousness is for all under heaven."

sentences.zh: 歷、諷等不識大典，而與群小共為歡嘩，外見忠直而內希後福，飾邪違義，豈事君之禮！

translations.literal: Li, Feng, and others do not understand the great canon yet join with petty men in noisy clamor, outwardly showing loyalty and straightness while inwardly hoping for later blessings, adorning perversity and violating righteousness—how is this the ritual of serving one's lord!
translations.idiomatic: Li, Feng, and others do not understand the great canon yet join with petty men in noisy clamor, outwardly showing loyalty and straightness while inwardly hoping for later blessings, adorning perversity and violating righteousness—how is this the ritual of serving one's lord!

sentences.zh: 朝廷廣開言事之路，故且一切假貸；

translations.literal: The court has broadly opened the path for memorializing, so for now all are provisionally pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: The court has broadly opened the path for memorializing, so for now all are provisionally pardoned;

sentences.zh: 若懷迷不反，當顯明刑書。

translations.literal: if you harbor delusion and do not turn back, the penal statutes will be made manifest."
translations.idiomatic: if you harbor delusion and do not turn back, the penal statutes will be made manifest."

sentences.zh: 」諫者莫不失色。

translations.literal: The remonstrators all changed color in fear.
translations.idiomatic: The remonstrators all changed color in fear.

sentences.zh: 薛皓先頓首曰：「固宜如明詔。

translations.literal: Xue Hao first kowtowed, saying: "It is indeed fitting to follow the luminous edict."
translations.idiomatic: Xue Hao first kowtowed, saying, "It is indeed fitting to follow the edict."

sentences.zh: 」歷怫然，廷詰皓曰：「屬通諫何言，而今復背之？

translations.literal: Li was angry and questioned Xue in court: "Just now when we joined in remonstrance what did you say—yet now you turn your back?"
translations.idiomatic: Li was angry and questioned Xue in court, "Just now when we joined in remonstrance what did you say—yet now you turn your back?"

sentences.zh: 大臣乘朝車，處國事，固得輾轉若此乎！

translations.literal: Great ministers riding the court carriage handling state affairs—can they really wheel about like this!
translations.idiomatic: Great ministers riding the court carriage and handling state affairs—can they really wheel about like this!

sentences.zh: 」乃各稍自引起。

translations.literal: They thereupon each gradually withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon each gradually withdrew.

sentences.zh: 歷獨守闕，連日不肯去。

translations.literal: Li alone guarded the gate, for days on end refusing to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Li alone guarded the gate and for days on end refused to leave.

sentences.zh: 帝不怒，尚書令陳忠與諸尚書遂共劾奏歷等，帝乃免歷兄弟官，削國租，黜歷母武安公主不得會見。

translations.literal: The Emperor was not angry; Director of the Secretariat Chen Zhong together with the various Directors memorialized impeaching Li and others; the Emperor then dismissed the offices of Li's brothers, cut their state revenue, and demoted Li's mother Princess Wu'an from being received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was not angry. Director of the Secretariat Chen Zhong together with the various Directors memorialized impeaching Li and others. The Emperor then dismissed the offices of Li's brothers, cut their state revenue, and barred Li's mother Princess Wu'an from audience.

sentences.zh: 隴西郡始還狄道。

translations.literal: Longxi Commandery for the first time returned to Didao.
translations.idiomatic: Longxi Commandery for the first time returned to Didao.

sentences.zh: 燒當羌豪麻奴死，弟犀苦立。

translations.literal: The Shaodang Qiang chieftain Manu died; his younger brother Xiku was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaodang Qiang chieftain Manu died. His younger brother Xiku was established.

sentences.zh: 庚申晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, gengshen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，上行幸長安；

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Emperor went on tour to Chang'an;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, the Emperor went on tour to Chang'an;

sentences.zh: 十一月，乙丑，還雒陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yichou day, he returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yichou day, he returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師及諸郡國二十三地震，三十六大水、雨雹。

translations.literal: That year the capital and twenty-three commanderies and states had earthquakes; thirty-six had great floods and hail.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital and twenty-three commanderies and states had earthquakes, and thirty-six had great floods and hail.
